AI.title_translation: 跨越领域鸿沟：从MIMIC-III到产科的监督式与零样本临床章节分割
AI.tldr: 作者创建产科标注数据集，比较监督模型与零样本大模型在章节分割中的表现，发现零样本模型在域外鲁棒性更佳。
AI.motivation: 现有临床章节分割多基于MIMIC-III，缺乏产科等域外数据；需评估监督模型与零样本大模型在域内外的表现差异，以推动临床NLP在更广泛医疗文本中的应用。
AI.method: 1) 策划并发布去标识化、带章节标签的产科病历数据集；2) 在MIMIC-III子集（域内）与产科数据（域外）上系统评估基于Transformer的监督式模型；3) 首次将监督模型与零样本大语言模型进行头对头比较，并校正零样本模型的幻觉标题。
AI.result: 监督模型在域内表现强劲，但在域外显著下降；零样本模型在域外表现出鲁棒适应性，校正幻觉后性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 开发领域专属临床资源至关重要；在适当管理幻觉前提下，零样本分割是把医疗NLP扩展至非经典语料的有前景方向。
AI.translation: 临床自由文本包含关键患者信息，其被结构化为带标签的章节；识别这些章节已被证明可支持临床决策及后续NLP任务。本文通过三项主要贡献推进临床章节分割：首先，策划一个新的去标识化、带章节标签的产科病历数据集，以补充MIMIC-III等公共语料未涵盖的医疗领域；其次，系统评估基于Transformer的监督式模型在MIMIC-III子集（域内）及新产科数据集（域外）上的章节分割性能；第三，首次对监督模型与零样本大语言模型进行直接比较。结果表明，监督模型在域内表现强劲，但在域外性能大幅下降；相反，零样本模型在纠正幻觉章节标题后展现出鲁棒的域外适应性。这些发现强调开发领域专属临床资源的重要性，并指出在适当管理幻觉情况下，零样本分割是将医疗NLP应用于更广语料的有前景方向。
AI.summary: 本文针对临床章节分割的域外泛化问题，提出产科标注数据集，并系统比较监督与零样本大模型。实验表明零样本方法在域外更具鲁棒性，为医疗NLP扩展提供新思路。
AI.keywords: 临床章节分割, 域适应, 零样本学习, 大语言模型, 产科病历, MIMIC-III, Transformer, 幻觉校正
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体模型名称、评估指标数值或代码开源情况。

title: RA-Nav: A Risk-Aware Navigation System Based on Semantic Segmentation for Aerial Robots in Unpredictable Environments
summary: Existing aerial robot navigation systems typically plan paths around static and dynamic obstacles, but fail to adapt when a static obstacle suddenly moves. Integrating environmental semantic awareness enables estimation of potential risks posed by suddenly moving obstacles. In this paper, we propose RA- Nav, a risk-aware navigation framework based on semantic segmentation. A lightweight multi-scale semantic segmentation network identifies obstacle categories in real time. These obstacles are further classified into three types: stationary, temporarily static, and dynamic. For each type, corresponding risk estimation functions are designed to enable real-time risk prediction, based on which a complete local risk map is constructed. Based on this map, the risk-informed path search algorithm is designed to guarantee planning that balances path efficiency and safety. Trajectory optimization is then applied to generate trajectories that are safe, smooth, and dynamically feasible. Comparative simulations demonstrate that RA-Nav achieves higher success rates than baselines in sudden obstacle state transition scenarios. Its effectiveness is further validated in simulations using real- world data.

AI.title_translation: RA-Nav：一种基于语义分割的面向风险感知的不可预测环境空中机器人导航系统
AI.tldr: 提出 RA-Nav，通过语义分割识别障碍物类别并量化运动风险，构建局部风险地图和风险感知规划，使无人机在静态障碍物突然移动等不可预测场景中获得更高成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有空中机器人导航系统只围绕静态和动态障碍物规划路径，难以在原本静止的障碍物突然移动时及时适应；引入环境语义信息可提前估计潜在突发运动风险，从而提升安全性和成功率。
AI.method: 提出 RA-Nav 风险感知导航框架：1）采用轻量级多尺度语义分割网络实时识别障碍物类别；2）根据语义和运动状态将障碍物划分为静止、暂时静止和动态三类；3）为三类障碍物分别设计风险估计函数，实现实时风险预测并构建局部风险地图；4）在风险地图上设计风险感知路径搜索算法，在路径效率与安全性之间权衡；5）通过轨迹优化生成安全、平滑且动力学可行的轨迹。
AI.result: 在包含障碍物状态突变（例如静止变为运动）的仿真场景中，RA-Nav 相比基线方法取得更高任务成功率；在使用真实世界数据的仿真中进一步验证了其有效性。具体定量指标和对比方法细节未在摘要中给出。
AI.conclusion: 语义分割驱动的风险感知机制能够有效刻画突然运动障碍物带来的潜在风险，通过局部风险地图、风险感知路径搜索与轨迹优化相结合，可在不可预测环境中显著提升空中机器人导航的安全性和任务成功率。
AI.translation: 现有空中机器人导航系统通常围绕静态和动态障碍物进行路径规划，但当静态障碍物突然移动时，它们难以及时适应。融合环境语义感知可以估计由突然运动障碍物带来的潜在风险。本文提出 RA-Nav，一种基于语义分割的风险感知导航框架。一个轻量级多尺度语义分割网络实时识别障碍物类别。随后将这些障碍物进一步划分为三类：静止、暂时静止和动态。针对每一类，设计相应的风险估计函数，实现实时风险预测，并据此构建完整的局部风险地图。在此基础上，设计风险感知路径搜索算法，以保证在路径效率和安全性之间取得平衡的规划。然后进行轨迹优化，以生成安全、平滑且动力学可行的轨迹。对比仿真实验表明，在突发障碍物状态转换场景中，RA-Nav 比基线方法获得更高的成功率。其有效性还在使用真实世界数据的仿真中得到了进一步验证。
AI.summary: 本文针对空中机器人在不可预测环境中面临的难题：静态障碍物可能突然变为运动体，传统仅区分静态/动态障碍的导航方法无法有效应对。作者提出 RA-Nav 风险感知导航系统，通过轻量级多尺度语义分割网络实时识别场景中的障碍物类别，并依据语义和运动特性将其划分为静止、暂时静止和动态三类。针对不同类型设计专门的风险估计函数，以在线构建局部风险地图。随后在该风险地图上运行风险感知路径搜索算法，实现对路径长度/时间与安全性的折中，并结合轨迹优化生成平滑且动力学可行的安全轨迹。仿真结果表明，在障碍物状态突然变化的场景中，该方法较基线具有更高的导航成功率，并在基于真实世界数据的仿真中获得验证。
AI.keywords: 空中机器人, 无人机导航, 风险感知, 语义分割, 多尺度网络, 局部风险地图, 路径规划, 轨迹优化, 动态障碍物, 不可预测环境
AI.comments: 摘要突出方法框架与应用场景，强调语义分割与风险建模对处理“静止变动态”障碍的价值，但未说明使用的具体数据集、网络结构细节、实时性能指标或是否有真实飞行实验；当前验证主要基于仿真和真实数据驱动的仿真。实际部署时，语义分割精度、延迟及环境多样性对风险估计的影响仍需进一步研究。

title: Computing the action of a matrix exponential on an interval via the $\star$-product approach
summary: We present a new method for computing the action of the matrix exponential on a vector, $e^{At}v$. The proposed approach efficiently evaluates the solution for all $t$ within a prescribed bounded interval by expanding it into an orthogonal polynomial series. This method is derived from a new representation of the matrix exponential in the so-called $\star$-algebra, an algebra of bivariate distributions. The resulting formulation leads to a linear system equivalent to a matrix equation of Stein type, which can be solved by either direct or Krylov subspace methods. Numerical experiments demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed approach in comparison with state-of-the-art techniques.

AI.title_translation: 通过 $★$-乘积方法在区间上计算矩阵指数对向量的作用
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于★-代数与正交多项式展开的新方法，高效计算有界时间区间内的矩阵指数作用 $e^{At}v$，数值结果优于现有技术。
AI.motivation: 在数值线性代数与微分方程求解中，需要高效且稳定地计算矩阵指数对向量的作用，尤其是希望在给定时间区间上获得 $e^{At}v$ 的整段演化；现有方法在效率或适用性上存在局限，因此需要新的高效算法。
AI.method: 将矩阵指数表示在所谓的 $★$-代数（双变量分布代数）框架下，得到一个适用于区间上所有 $t$ 的表示；进一步将解在时间维上展开为正交多项式级数，最终转化为一个与 Stein 型矩阵方程等价的线性系统，并采用直接法或 Krylov 子空间方法求解该线性系统。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，相较于当前最先进的相关算法，该方法在计算 $e^{At}v$ 于整个有界时间区间上的数值解时，具有较高的精度和较好的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 基于 $★$-代数表示与正交多项式展开的框架，为在区间上计算矩阵指数对向量的作用提供了一种可行且高效的途径，并通过 Stein 型线性系统求解实现了与现有先进方法相比具有竞争力甚至更优的性能。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于计算矩阵指数对向量作用 $e^{At}v$ 的新方法。该方法通过将解在给定有界时间区间内的所有 $t$ 上展开为正交多项式级数，从而高效地评估解。此方法源于在所谓的 $★$-代数——一个由双变量分布构成的代数——中对矩阵指数的一种新表示。由此得到的公式可转化为一个与 Stein 型矩阵方程等价的线性系统，该系统可以通过直接法或 Krylov 子空间方法求解。数值实验表明，与当前最先进的技术相比，所提出方法在精度和效率方面表现良好。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种在给定有界时间区间上统一计算 $e^{At}v$ 的新算法。作者在双变量分布构成的 $★$-代数中给出了矩阵指数的新表示形式，并由此推导出一种基于时间方向正交多项式展开的表示，将原问题转化为求解一个与 Stein 型矩阵方程等价的线性代数系统。该线性系统既可以用直接求解方式，也可利用 Krylov 子空间方法高效求解。数值实验显示，该方法在精度与计算效率上均能与现有最优方法竞争甚至更有优势，适合需要在整个时间区间内评估矩阵指数作用的应用场景。
AI.keywords: 矩阵指数; $e^{At}v$; ★-代数; ★-乘积; 正交多项式展开; Stein 型矩阵方程; Krylov 子空间方法; 数值线性代数; 时间区间求解
AI.comments: 方法的核心创新在于利用 $★$-代数中的新表示，将时间连续问题转写为可通过线性系统求解的代数问题；抽象层次较高，但通过与 Stein 方程和 Krylov 技术的联系，使其落地为可实现的数值算法。具体在大规模问题上的可扩展性和对不同矩阵结构（如非正规、刚性系统）的表现，需进一步从正文和更多实验中评估。

title: FoundationPose-Initialized 3D-2D Liver Registration for Surgical Augmented Reality
summary: Augmented reality can improve tumor localization in laparoscopic liver surgery. Existing registration pipelines typically depend on organ contours; deformable (non-rigid) alignment is often handled with finite-element (FE) models coupled to dimensionality-reduction or machine-learning components. We integrate laparoscopic depth maps with a foundation pose estimator for camera-liver pose estimation and replace FE-based deformation with non-rigid iterative closest point (NICP) to lower engineering/modeling complexity and expertise requirements. On real patient data, the depth-augmented foundation pose approach achieved 9.91 mm mean registration error in 3 cases. Combined rigid-NICP registration outperformed rigid-only registration, demonstrating NICP as an efficient substitute for finite-element deformable models. This pipeline achieves clinically relevant accuracy while offering a lightweight, engineering-friendly alternative to FE-based deformation.

AI.title_translation: 基于 FoundationPose 初始化的 3D-2D 肝脏配准用于外科增强现实
AI.tldr: 提出一种利用深度增强的 FoundationPose 和非刚性 ICP 的轻量级 3D-2D 肝脏配准方案，在真实病例中达到约 1 cm 的注册误差，可替代复杂的有限元形变模型用于腹腔镜肝脏手术增强现实。
AI.motivation: 在腹腔镜肝脏手术中，增强现实有助于术中肿瘤定位，但现有配准流程往往依赖器官轮廓和有限元形变模型，这些方案工程实现复杂、对建模与专业知识要求高，因此需要一种工程友好、但仍具备临床精度的替代方法。
AI.method: 将腹腔镜深度图与一个通用的 foundation pose 估计器相结合，用于相机与肝脏的初始位姿估计（3D-2D 配准初始化），然后使用非刚性迭代最近点（NICP）算法替代传统的有限元（FE）形变模型，实现从刚性到非刚性的配准流程，从而降低建模和工程实现的复杂度与专业门槛。
AI.result: 在真实患者数据上（3 例），深度增强的 foundation pose 方法达到了 9.91 mm 的平均配准误差；在配准性能上，刚性+NICP 组合优于仅刚性配准，表明 NICP 可以有效替代有限元变形模型实现非刚性配准。
AI.conclusion: 以 foundation pose 和 NICP 为核心的配准流程在真实病例中达到了临床相关的精度，同时显著降低了对复杂有限元建模和专业知识的依赖，提供了一种轻量化、工程友好的 FE 形变模型替代方案，适用于腹腔镜肝脏手术的增强现实导航。
AI.translation:
论文题目：
基于 FoundationPose 初始化的 3D-2D 肝脏配准用于外科增强现实

摘要：
增强现实可以改善腹腔镜肝脏手术中的肿瘤定位。现有的配准流程通常依赖器官轮廓；可变形（非刚性）对准往往通过将有限元（FE）模型与降维或机器学习组件相结合来实现。我们将腹腔镜深度图与一个基础位姿估计器集成，用于相机-肝脏位姿估计，并用非刚性迭代最近点（NICP）替代基于有限元的形变，以降低工程/建模复杂度和专业知识需求。在真实患者数据上，深度增强的基础位姿方法在 3 例中达到了 9.91 mm 的平均配准误差。将刚性配准与 NICP 结合的方案优于仅刚性配准，证明 NICP 是有限元可变形模型的高效替代。本流程在提供临床相关精度的同时，作为一种轻量、工程友好的有限元形变替代方案具有可行性。
AI.summary: 本文针对腹腔镜肝脏手术中的增强现实导航，提出了一种以 FoundationPose 初始化、结合深度图和非刚性 ICP 的 3D-2D 肝脏配准框架。该方法用 NICP 替代传统有限元形变模型，从而简化工程实现并降低对专业建模的依赖。在 3 例真实患者数据上，平均配准误差约为 9.91 mm，且刚性+NICP 配准优于仅刚性方案，表明在保持临床可用精度的前提下，该方法可以作为有限元可变形配准的轻量替代。
AI.keywords: 增强现实, 腹腔镜肝脏手术, 3D-2D 配准, FoundationPose, 深度图, 相机-肝脏位姿估计, 非刚性迭代最近点 (NICP), 有限元模型, 形变配准, 外科导航
AI.comments: 工作亮点在于将通用 pose foundation 模型与腹腔镜深度信息结合，用简单的 NICP 代替有限元可变形模型，工程和部署成本更低。实验仅在 3 例真实患者数据上进行，样本规模和场景多样性有待扩展；对比也主要是刚性 vs 刚性+NICP，与主流 FE 或学习型方法的系统性对比尚未展示。若能进一步分析不同肝脏变形程度、遮挡和噪声条件下的鲁棒性，以及实时性能，将更有助于评估其临床推广潜力。

title: A Picture of Agentic Search
summary: With automated systems increasingly issuing search queries alongside humans, Information Retrieval (IR) faces a major shift. Yet IR remains human-centred, with systems, evaluation metrics, user models, and datasets designed around human queries and behaviours. Consequently, IR operates under assumptions that no longer hold in practice, with changes to workload volumes, predictability, and querying behaviours. This misalignment affects system performance and optimisation: caching may lose effectiveness, query pre-processing may add overhead without improving results, and standard metrics may mismeasure satisfaction. Without adaptation, retrieval models risk satisfying neither humans, nor the emerging user segment of agents. However, datasets capturing agent search behaviour are lacking, which is a critical gap given IR's historical reliance on data-driven evaluation and optimisation. We develop a methodology for collecting all the data produced and consumed by agentic retrieval-augmented systems when answering queries, and we release the Agentic Search Queryset (ASQ) dataset. ASQ contains reasoning-induced queries, retrieved documents, and thoughts for queries in HotpotQA, Researchy Questions, and MS MARCO, for 3 diverse agents and 2 retrieval pipelines. The accompanying toolkit enables ASQ to be extended to new agents, retrievers, and datasets.

AI.title_translation: 代理式搜索图景
AI.tldr: 论文指出传统信息检索(IR)以人为中心，无法适应代理系统大量发起查询的新现实，导致缓存失效、预处理开销、指标失真等问题；作者提出采集代理检索增强系统全链路数据的方法，发布涵盖3类代理、2条检索管线、3个数据集的Agentic Search Queryset(ASQ)及扩展工具包。
AI.motivation: 随着自动化系统与人类共同发起搜索查询，IR面临范式转变，但现有系统、评估指标、用户模型和数据集仍以人为中心，缺乏代理行为数据，导致性能优化与评估失真，亟需代理搜索行为数据以重新校准IR系统。
AI.method: 设计一套采集代理检索增强系统在回答查询时产生与消费的全部数据的方法；构建ASQ数据集，涵盖HotpotQA、Researchy Questions、MS MARCO上的推理驱动查询、检索文档与思维链，支持3种不同代理与2条检索管线；提供可扩展工具包，便于将ASQ扩展至新代理、检索器与数据集。
AI.result: ASQ数据集已发布，包含多场景代理搜索行为数据，配套工具包支持快速扩展至新代理与检索器，为IR社区提供首个系统级代理查询资源。
AI.conclusion: 若不对IR进行适应性改造，检索模型将既无法满足人类，也无法满足新兴代理用户；ASQ填补代理行为数据空白，为数据驱动的IR评估与优化提供基础，推动IR从以人为中心转向人机代理混合范式。
AI.translation: 随着自动化系统与人类共同发出搜索查询，信息检索(IR)面临重大转变。然而IR仍以人为中心，系统、评估指标、用户模型和数据集均围绕人类查询与行为设计。因此，IR在实际中基于不再成立的假设运行，工作负载量、可预测性与查询行为均发生变化。这种错位影响系统性能与优化：缓存可能失效，查询预处理可能增加开销却未改善结果，标准指标可能误测满意度。若不调整，检索模型将既无法满足人类，也无法满足新兴的代理用户段。然而，捕捉代理搜索行为的数据集缺失，鉴于IR历史上依赖数据驱动的评估与优化，这是关键缺口。我们开发了一种方法，收集代理式检索增强系统在回答查询时产生与消费的全部数据，并发布Agentic Search Queryset(ASQ)数据集。ASQ包含HotpotQA、Researchy Questions与MS MARCO上由推理驱动的查询、检索文档与思维链，覆盖3类不同代理与2条检索管线。配套工具包支持将ASQ扩展至新代理、检索器与数据集。
AI.summary: 本文揭示传统IR以人为中心的架构在面对代理系统大量查询时出现的性能与评估错位，提出采集代理检索全链路数据的方法，发布首个系统级代理搜索数据集ASQ及扩展工具，为IR适应人机代理混合新范式提供数据基础与方法论支持。
AI.keywords: 代理搜索;信息检索;数据集;检索增强生成;查询行为;系统评估
AI.comments: ASQ的推出为IR社区提供了研究代理查询特性的关键资源，但需进一步验证其在真实部署环境中的代表性与规模效应，并探索如何基于ASQ重新设计缓存、预处理与评估机制。

title: When Models Ignore Definitions: Measuring Semantic Override Hallucinations in LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong performance on standard digital logic and Boolean reasoning tasks, yet their reliability under locally redefined semantics remains poorly understood. In many formal settings, such as circuit specifications, examinations, and hardware documentation, operators and components are explicitly redefined within narrow scope. Correct reasoning in these contexts requires models to temporarily suppress globally learned conventions in favor of prompt-local definitions. In this work, we study a systematic failure mode we term semantic override, in which an LLM reverts to its pretrained default interpretation of operators or gate behavior despite explicit redefinition in the prompt. We also identify a related class of errors, assumption injection, where models commit to unstated hardware semantics when critical details are underspecified, rather than requesting clarification. We introduce a compact micro-benchmark of 30 logic and digital-circuit reasoning tasks designed as verifier-style traps, spanning Boolean algebra, operator overloading, redefined gates, and circuit-level semantics. Evaluating three frontier LLMs, we observe persistent noncompliance with local specifications, confident but incompatible assumptions, and dropped constraints even in elementary settings. Our findings highlight a gap between surface-level correctness and specification-faithful reasoning, motivating evaluation protocols that explicitly test local unlearning and semantic compliance in formal domains.

AI.title_translation: 当模型无视定义时：衡量大模型推理中的语义覆盖型幻觉
AI.tldr: 本文提出“语义覆盖”(semantic override)与“假设注入”(assumption injection)两类在局部重定义语义下的系统性错误，并构建一个包含30个数字逻辑与电路任务的微基准，以评估前沿LLM在遵守局部规格与语义合规方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 在电路规格、考试、硬件文档等形式化场景中，运算符和元件常被在局部范围内重新定义，正确推理需要模型临时放弃预训练的全局语义；然而现有工作很少系统性研究LLM在这种局部重定义语义下的可靠性与失效模式。
AI.method: 作者定义并分析了两类错误：语义覆盖（在有明确重定义时仍退回预训练默认语义）和假设注入（在关键信息缺失时自行补全未声明的硬件语义而不求澄清），并据此设计了一个由30个数字逻辑与电路推理任务构成的紧凑微基准，这些任务以“验证者陷阱”的形式覆盖布尔代数、运算符重载、重新定义的逻辑门以及电路级语义，随后在三款前沿LLM上进行系统评测。
AI.result: 在这30道逻辑与电路任务上，三款前沿LLM均表现出持续性的规范不服从：频繁无视局部规格、做出自信但与规格不兼容的假设，并遗漏关键约束，即便在相对基础的推理情形也存在此类问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM在表面上看似能够完成数字逻辑和布尔推理任务，但在需要遵守局部重定义语义和规格时存在明显缺陷，暴露出“表层正确”与“真正符合规格的推理”之间的差距，因此有必要设计专门评测模型局部“反学习”能力和语义合规性的评价协议，尤其在形式化领域。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在标准数字逻辑和布尔推理任务上表现出较强能力，但其在局部重新定义语义条件下的可靠性仍缺乏深入理解。在许多形式化情境中，如电路规格说明、考试和硬件文档中，运算符和组件会在狭窄范围内被显式重定义。在这些情境下进行正确推理，需要模型暂时压制其全局学习到的惯常用法，而遵从提示中局部给出的定义。在这项工作中，我们研究了一种系统性失效模式，称为语义覆盖（semantic override）：即LLM在提示中已有明确重定义的情况下，仍回退到其预训练阶段对运算符或逻辑门行为的默认解释。我们还识别出一类相关错误，称为假设注入（assumption injection）：当关键硬件细节未被充分说明时，模型不请求澄清，而是主动采用未明示的硬件语义。我们提出了一个紧凑的微基准，包含30个逻辑与数字电路推理任务，这些任务以验证者式“陷阱”形式构造，覆盖布尔代数、运算符重载、重新定义的逻辑门和电路级语义。对三款前沿LLM的评测显示，即便在基础场景中，它们仍持续表现出对局部规格的不遵守、自信但与规格不兼容的假设以及对约束条件的遗漏。我们的发现凸显了表层正确性与真正符合规格的推理之间的差距，进而呼吁在形式化领域采用能够显式考察局部“反学习”和语义合规性的评估协议。
AI.summary: 本文聚焦LLM在“局部重定义语义”场景（如电路文档和考试中重载运算符或重定义逻辑门）下的可靠性，提出两类系统性错误：语义覆盖（无视局部重定义，回退预训练语义）和假设注入（在信息不全时私自补充硬件语义）。作者构建了一个包含30个逻辑与数字电路推理任务的微基准，将这些任务设计成检测模型是否严格遵从规格的“验证者陷阱”。在三款前沿LLM上的实验表明，模型普遍存在不遵从局部定义、自信但错误的假设以及遗漏约束等问题，说明当前模型的表面推理能力与真正按规格推理之间仍存在明显鸿沟，亟需面向语义合规性和局部“反学习”能力的新评测方法。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 数字逻辑推理, 布尔推理, 语义覆盖, 幻觉, 假设注入, 运算符重载, 电路语义, 规格遵从性, 基准评测
AI.comments: 文章强调的是一种较隐蔽但在工程实践中极关键的失效模式：模型对局部定义的“抗拒”与自动补全默认语义。微基准任务仅有30题，规模较小，但胜在针对性强、结构清晰，更像是“安全带性质”的验证集而非大规模基准。抽象中未涉及缓解方法或训练干预方案，因此当前贡献主要在于问题刻画与诊断工具，后续工作可基于此探索如何显式训练或约束模型遵从局部规格，以及如何在交互中鼓励模型请求澄清而非进行假设注入。

title: Variational inference via radial transport
summary: In variational inference (VI), the practitioner approximates a high-dimensional distribution $π$ with a simple surrogate one, often a (product) Gaussian distribution. However, in many cases of practical interest, Gaussian distributions might not capture the correct radial profile of $π$, resulting in poor coverage. In this work, we approach the VI problem from the perspective of optimizing over these radial profiles. Our algorithm radVI is a cheap, effective add-on to many existing VI schemes, such as Gaussian (mean-field) VI and Laplace approximation. We provide theoretical convergence guarantees for our algorithm, owing to recent developments in optimization over the Wasserstein space--the space of probability distributions endowed with the Wasserstein distance--and new regularity properties of radial transport maps in the style of Caffarelli (2000).

AI.title_translation: 基于径向传输的变分推断
AI.tldr: radVI：一种优化径向分布的变分推断附加算法，适用于高斯变分推断和拉普拉斯近似，提供理论收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 现有变分推断方法常使用高斯分布近似高维分布π，但可能无法准确捕捉π的径向特性，导致覆盖不佳。
AI.method: 从优化径向分布的角度出发，提出附加算法radVI，可结合现有变分推断方案（如高斯（均值场）变分推断和拉普拉斯近似）。
AI.result: 基于Wasserstein空间优化和Caffarelli风格径向传输映射的新正则性，提供了理论收敛保证。
AI.conclusion: radVI是一种廉价有效的附加算法，能改善径向分布覆盖问题，适用于多种变分推断方案。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文针对变分推断中高斯分布无法准确捕捉高维分布径向特性导致覆盖不佳的问题，提出了一种优化径向分布的附加算法radVI。该算法可结合高斯变分推断和拉普拉斯近似等现有方案，并基于Wasserstein空间优化理论和径向传输映射的正则性，提供了理论收敛保证。
AI.keywords: 变分推断, 径向传输, 高斯近似, 径向分布优化, Wasserstein空间, 收敛保证
AI.comments: 论文聚焦于改进变分推断的径向覆盖问题，方法具有普适性和理论支撑，但摘要未提及实验验证或具体应用案例。

title: The Anxiety of Influence: Bloom Filters in Transformer Attention Heads
comments: 13 pages, 8 figures, code at https://github.com/pbalogh/anxiety-of-influence v2: L3H0 reclassified as prefix-attention head following confound control. Capacity analysis updated. Duplicate-token head overlap experiment added v3: All experiments were independently validated on CPU to rule out hardware-specific computation artifacts. Results are consistent across backends
summary: Some transformer attention heads appear to function as membership testers, dedicating themselves to answering the question "has this token appeared before in the context?" We identify these heads across four language models (GPT-2 small, medium, and large; Pythia-160M) and show that they form a spectrum of membership-testing strategies. Two heads (L0H1 and L0H5 in GPT-2 small) function as high-precision membership filters with false positive rates of 0-4\% even at 180 unique context tokens -- well above the $d_\text{head} = 64$ bit capacity of a classical Bloom filter. A third head (L1H11) shows the classic Bloom filter capacity curve: its false positive rate follows the theoretical formula $p \approx (1 - e^{-kn/m})^k$ with $R^2 = 1.0$ and fitted capacity $m \approx 5$ bits, saturating by $n \approx 20$ unique tokens. A fourth head initially identified as a Bloom filter (L3H0) was reclassified as a general prefix-attention head after confound controls revealed its apparent capacity curve was a sequence-length artifact. Together, the three genuine membership-testing heads form a multi-resolution system concentrated in early layers (0-1), taxonomically distinct from induction and previous-token heads, with false positive rates that decay monotonically with embedding distance -- consistent with distance-sensitive Bloom filters. These heads generalize broadly: they respond to any repeated token type, not just repeated names, with 43\% higher generalization than duplicate-token-only heads. Ablation reveals these heads contribute to both repeated and novel token processing, indicating that membership testing coexists with broader computational roles. The reclassification of L3H0 through confound controls strengthens rather than weakens the case: the surviving heads withstand the scrutiny that eliminated a false positive in our own analysis.
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, code at https://github.com/pbalogh/anxiety-of-influence v2: L3H0 reclassified as prefix-attention head following confound control. Capacity analysis updated. Duplicate-token head overlap experiment added v3: All experiments were independently validated on CPU to rule out hardware-specific computation artifacts. Results are consistent across backends

AI.title_translation: 影响之焦虑：Transformer注意力头中的布隆过滤器
AI.tldr: 研究发现部分Transformer注意力头充当成员资格测试器，像布隆过滤器一样判断token是否曾在上下文中出现，并在GPT-2和Pythia模型中识别出三个真正的成员测试头。
AI.motivation: 探究Transformer注意力机制中是否存在专门用于检测token是否重复出现的结构，并验证其是否表现出类似布隆过滤器的行为特征。
AI.method: 在四种语言模型中系统搜索成员测试头，测量其假阳性率并与经典布隆过滤器理论曲线拟合；通过控制混杂变量重新分类可疑头；对识别出的头进行消融实验评估其功能。
AI.result: 发现三个真正的成员测试头集中于早期层，假阳性率随嵌入距离单调下降，对任意重复token类型的泛化能力比仅检测重复名称的头高43%，且同时参与重复与全新token处理。
AI.conclusion: Transformer中存在专门且鲁棒的成员测试注意力头，它们构成多分辨率系统，与归纳头和前一token头在分类上不同，表明成员测试与更广泛计算角色共存。
AI.translation: 一些Transformer注意力头似乎充当成员测试器，专门回答“此token是否曾在上下文中出现”这一问题。我们在四种语言模型（GPT-2 small、medium、large及Pythia-160M）中识别这些头，并发现它们形成成员测试策略谱系。两个头（GPT-2 small的L0H1和L0H5）作为高精度成员过滤器，即使在180个唯一上下文token时假阳性率仍仅0–4%，远超经典布隆过滤器64位容量。第三个头（L1H11）呈现经典布隆过滤器容量曲线：其假阳性率遵循理论公式p≈(1−e^(−kn/m))^k，R²=1.0，拟合容量m≈5位，在约20个唯一token时饱和。第四个头（L3H0）初被归为布隆过滤器，经混杂控制后重归为通用前缀注意力头，其表观容量曲线实为序列长度伪影。三个真正的成员测试头共同构成多分辨率系统，集中于早期层（0–1），分类上区别于归纳头和前一token头，假阳性率随嵌入距离单调下降，符合距离敏感布隆过滤器特征。这些头泛化广泛：对任何重复token类型均有响应，比仅检测重复名称的头泛化率高43%。消融表明它们同时参与重复与全新token处理，显示成员测试与更广泛计算角色共存。通过混杂控制重分类L3H0反而强化结论：幸存头经住了排除自身假阳性的严格检验。
AI.summary: 论文识别出Transformer早期层中存在专门用于判断token是否曾出现的注意力头，它们表现出类似布隆过滤器的高精度成员测试行为，并形成多分辨率系统，对重复token具有强泛化能力，同时参与更广泛的计算任务。
AI.keywords: 布隆过滤器,注意力头,成员测试,Transformer,假阳性率,上下文重复检测
AI.comments: 研究通过严谨控制混杂变量，避免了将序列长度效应误判为容量限制，为理解Transformer内部机制提供了新的成员测试视角，并展示了注意力头可兼具专用与通用计算功能。

title: Enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) for Telecom using Dynamic Knowledge Graphs and Explainable Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential across a variety of tasks, but their application in the telecom field remains challenging due to domain complexity, evolving standards, and specialized terminology. Therefore, general-domain LLMs may struggle to provide accurate and reliable outputs in this context, leading to increased hallucinations and reduced utility in telecom operations.To address these limitations, this work introduces KG-RAG-a novel framework that integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to enhance LLMs for telecom-specific tasks. In particular, the KG provides a structured representation of domain knowledge derived from telecom standards and technical documents, while RAG enables dynamic retrieval of relevant facts to ground the model's outputs. Such a combination improves factual accuracy, reduces hallucination, and ensures compliance with telecom specifications.Experimental results across benchmark datasets demonstrate that KG-RAG outperforms both LLM-only and standard RAG baselines, e.g., KG-RAG achieves an average accuracy improvement of 14.3% over RAG and 21.6% over LLM-only models. These results highlight KG-RAG's effectiveness in producing accurate, reliable, and explainable outputs in complex telecom scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 利用动态知识图谱和可解释的检索增强生成提升电信领域大语言模型能力
AI.tldr: 提出将知识图谱与检索增强生成结合的KG-RAG框架，在电信任务上显著提升LLM准确性并降低幻觉，且具有可解释性。
AI.motivation: 通信用例具有复杂领域知识、不断演进的标准和专门术语，通用大模型在该领域易出现幻觉和不符合标准的回答，影响在电信运营中的实用性，因此需要一种能更好利用电信领域结构化知识、提升准确性与可靠性的方案。
AI.method: 提出KG-RAG框架，将从电信标准与技术文档中构建的知识图谱与检索增强生成相结合：知识图谱提供结构化领域知识，RAG动态检索相关事实并用于约束和支撑LLM生成，从而提升事实一致性与可解释性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，KG-RAG相较标准RAG平均准确率提升14.3%，相较仅用LLM提升21.6%，在复杂电信场景中生成更准确、可靠且可解释的输出。
AI.conclusion: 通过将知识图谱与RAG结合，KG-RAG有效缓解了LLM在电信领域的幻觉和不可靠问题，显著提升了任务准确性与对电信规范的遵从度，验证了该框架在复杂电信应用中的实用价值。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在多种任务上展现出强大潜力，但由于电信领域的复杂性、不断演进的标准以及专业术语，其在电信场景中的应用仍然充满挑战。因此，通用领域的LLM在这一背景下可能难以给出准确可靠的输出，导致幻觉增加并降低其在电信运营中的实用性。为解决这些局限，本文提出KG-RAG——一种将知识图谱（KG）与检索增强生成（RAG）相集成的新型框架，用于增强LLM在电信特定任务上的表现。具体而言，知识图谱提供从电信标准和技术文档中提取的结构化领域知识表示，而RAG则支持对相关事实的动态检索，以此作为模型输出的依据。这样的结合提升了事实准确性，减少了幻觉，并确保对电信规范的遵从。基准数据集上的实验结果表明，KG-RAG优于仅使用LLM以及标准RAG的基线方法，例如，KG-RAG相对RAG实现了平均14.3%的准确率提升，相对仅用LLM模型提升了21.6%。这些结果突显了KG-RAG在复杂电信场景中生成准确、可靠且可解释输出方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文面向电信领域大模型应用难的问题，提出KG-RAG框架，将从电信标准与技术文档构建的知识图谱与检索增强生成机制结合：先利用知识图谱组织和表达电信领域的结构化知识，再通过RAG动态检索与当前问题相关的图谱事实，并将其注入LLM生成过程，以减少幻觉并保证符合规范。实验表明，KG-RAG在多个电信相关基准数据集上的准确率相较标准RAG提高14.3%，相较仅用LLM提高21.6%，在复杂电信场景下实现了更高的准确性、可靠性和可解释性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 电信, 知识图谱, 检索增强生成, KG-RAG, 幻觉减少, 领域知识, 可解释性
AI.comments: 工作针对电信这一高度规范化、术语密集的难点领域，采用知识图谱+RAG的组合是自然且实用的设计；但摘要未说明知识图谱构建成本、动态更新机制与对其他垂直领域的可迁移性，后续可在可扩展性与维护成本方面进一步量化。

title: Provably Explaining Neural Additive Models
summary:
Despite significant progress in post-hoc explanation methods for neural networks, many remain heuristic and lack provable guarantees. A key approach for obtaining explanations with provable guarantees is by identifying a cardinally-minimal subset of input features which by itself is provably sufficient to determine the prediction. However, for standard neural networks, this task is often computationally infeasible, as it demands a worst-case exponential number of verification queries in the number of input features, each of which is NP-hard.
  In this work, we show that for Neural Additive Models (NAMs), a recent and more interpretable neural network family, we can efficiently generate explanations with such guarantees. We present a new model-specific algorithm for NAMs that generates provably cardinally-minimal explanations using only a logarithmic number of verification queries
  in the number of input features, after a parallelized preprocessing step with logarithmic runtime in the required precision is applied to each small univariate NAM component.
  Our algorithm not only makes the task of obtaining cardinally-minimal explanations feasible, but even outperforms existing algorithms designed to find the relaxed variant of subset-minimal explanations - which may be larger and less informative but easier to compute - despite our algorithm solving a much more difficult task.
  Our experiments demonstrate that, compared to previous algorithms, our approach provides provably smaller explanations than existing works and substantially reduces the computation time. Moreover, we show that our generated provable explanations offer benefits that are unattainable by standard sampling-based techniques typically used to interpret NAMs.

AI.title_translation: 对神经加性模型的可证明解释
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对神经加性模型的高效算法，能够在有理论保证的条件下找到输入特征的基数最小解释子集，并在解释质量和计算效率上都优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有针对神经网络的事后解释方法多为启发式，缺乏可证明的保证；要获得有理论保证的解释，需要找到在预测上足够且基数最小的特征子集，但对通用神经网络而言，这通常在计算上不可行（需指数级次数的验证查询且每次查询为 NP 难）。作者希望在更可解释的神经加性模型（NAM）框架下，使这一任务变得可行且高效。
AI.method: 针对神经加性模型设计了一个模型特定算法：在对每个一元 NAM 组件进行可并行的预处理（在所需精度上具有对数级运行时间）之后，整体算法只需对数级数量的验证查询（相对于输入特征数目为对数级）即可生成在预测上充分且基数最小的解释特征子集，并具备理论正确性与最优性保证。
AI.result: 实验表明，该算法在多个数据集上生成的特征子集解释在规模上严格更小（更精炼）且带有可证明的基数最小性，相比现有仅求“子集最小”（但不保证基数最小）的算法，不但解释更紧凑，而且整体计算时间显著降低；此外，与常用的基于采样的 NAM 解释技术相比，该方法还能提供后者无法获得的可证明性质和更高质量的解释。
AI.conclusion: 利用神经加性模型的结构特性，可以在合理的时间复杂度内获得对预测足够且在特征数量上严格最小的解释子集，并给出形式化保证；该方法在实践中既更高效又能产生更精炼的解释，说明在可解释模型家族内进行结构化算法设计是实现可证明可解释性的有效途径。
AI.translation:
尽管针对神经网络的事后解释方法已有显著进展，但许多方法仍然是启发式的，缺乏可证明的保证。一种获得具有可证明保证解释的关键途径，是识别一个在基数意义上最小的输入特征子集，使得仅凭这一子集就足以在形式上确定模型的预测。然而，对于标准神经网络而言，这一任务在计算上往往不可行，因为它在最坏情况下需要相对于输入特征数量的指数级验证查询次数，而每一次查询本身又是 NP 难的。
在本工作中，我们表明，对于神经加性模型（NAM）这一近年来提出且更具可解释性的神经网络家族，我们可以高效地生成带有此类保证的解释。我们提出了一种针对 NAM 的新型模型特定算法，它能够生成具有可证明基数最小性的解释，并且仅需相对于输入特征数量对数级的验证查询；这依赖于对每个规模较小的一元 NAM 组件进行一次并行化的预处理步骤，而该预处理在所需精度上具有对数级运行时间。
我们的算法不仅使得获得基数最小解释这一原本难以实现的任务变得可行，甚至在性能上超过了现有旨在寻找“子集最小”解释的算法——后者得到的解释可能更大、信息量更低，但计算更容易——尽管我们的算法解决的是一个更加困难的问题。实验结果表明，与以往算法相比，我们的方法能提供在理论上更小的解释，并大幅降低计算时间。此外，我们展示了，相较于通常用于解释 NAM 的标准采样型技术，我们生成的具有可证明性质的解释还能带来后者无法实现的优势。
AI.summary: 本文聚焦于如何为神经加性模型构造具有严格理论保证的特征子集解释。作者指出，在通用神经网络上寻找对预测足够且在特征数量上最小的子集在计算上近乎不可行，而 NAM 的结构为突破这一瓶颈提供了机会。为此，作者设计了一个专门针对 NAM 的算法：先对每个一元子模型做并行预处理，以对数级时间获得可验证的近似结构，然后在整体层面用对数级数量的形式验证查询，精确找出在预测上足够且基数最小的特征子集。理论上，该算法保证解释的正确性和最小性；实验上，它在解释规模和运行时间上都优于现有只能求“子集最小”解释的通用方法，并展示出相较标准采样解释技术的明显优势，表明在可解释模型家族内进行结构化算法设计可以大幅提升可解释性的质量与效率。
AI.keywords: 神经加性模型, 可解释人工智能, 事后解释, 基数最小特征子集, 可证明保证, 验证查询, 模型特定算法, 形式验证
AI.comments: 工作依托于神经加性模型这一特定结构假设，因此适用性主要限于 NAM 而非任意深度网络；算法关键在于对一元组件的并行预处理与对数级验证查询，具体实现细节及对高维、复杂数据的扩展在摘要中尚未披露。实验虽显示优于现有方法，但数据集范围和对比细节也未在摘要中详细说明。

title: Position: Evaluation of ECG Representations Must Be Fixed
summary: This position paper argues that current benchmarking practice in 12-lead ECG representation learning must be fixed to ensure progress is reliable and aligned with clinically meaningful objectives. The field has largely converged on three public multi-label benchmarks (PTB-XL, CPSC2018, CSN) dominated by arrhythmia and waveform-morphology labels, even though the ECG is known to encode substantially broader clinical information. We argue that downstream evaluation should expand to include an assessment of structural heart disease and patient-level forecasting, in addition to other evolving ECG-related endpoints, as relevant clinical targets. Next, we outline evaluation best practices for multi-label, imbalanced settings, and show that when they are applied, the literature's current conclusion about which representations perform best is altered. Furthermore, we demonstrate the surprising result that a randomly initialized encoder with linear evaluation matches state-of-the-art pre-training on many tasks. This motivates the use of a random encoder as a reasonable baseline model. We substantiate our observations with an empirical evaluation of three representative ECG pre-training approaches across six evaluation settings: the three standard benchmarks, a structural disease dataset, hemodynamic inference, and patient forecasting.

AI.title_translation: 立场：心电图表示评估必须修正
AI.tldr: 心电图表示学习的基准测试存在缺陷，需扩展评估范围至结构性心脏病和患者预测，并应用最佳实践以修正结论；随机编码器可作为基线模型。
AI.motivation: 当前心电图表示学习的基准测试实践主要集中在心律失常和波形形态标签上，而心电图编码了更广泛的临床信息，这限制了可靠进展并与临床目标脱节。需修正评估方法以确保进步可靠且符合临床意义。
AI.method: 本文提出通过扩展下游评估范围来修正基准测试，包括结构性心脏病和患者预测等其他相关临床目标；概述多标签、不平衡设置下的评估最佳实践；通过经验评估三种代表性心电图预训练方法在六个评估设置中验证观察。
AI.result: 应用评估最佳实践改变了当前文献中关于哪些表示性能最好的结论；随机初始化编码器与线性评估在许多任务上匹配了最先进的预训练性能。
AI.conclusion: 心电图表示学习的基准测试必须修正，以涵盖更广泛的临床目标和应用最佳实践；随机编码器可作为合理的基线模型，这强调了改进评估方法的重要性。
AI.translation: 本文立场认为，心电图表示学习的当前基准测试实践必须修正，以确保进展可靠并符合临床目标；通过扩展评估范围和采用最佳实践，修正了性能结论，并发现随机编码器可作为基线。
AI.summary: 该立场论文指出，心电图表示学习的基准测试主要依赖有限标签，忽视了心电图编码的更广泛临床信息，因此必须修正评估方法。通过扩展下游评估范围（如结构性心脏病和患者预测）和应用最佳实践，研究发现当前结论被改变，且随机编码器能匹配前沿预训练性能。这强调了使用随机编码器作为基线，并呼吁改进评估以促进可靠进展。
AI.keywords: 心电图表示学习, 基准测试, 结构性心脏病, 患者预测, 随机编码器
AI.comments: 本文明确指出了当前心电图研究中的评估缺陷，并提出了切实可行的修正方案，如扩展评估范围和优化方法，具有临床和学术价值；随机编码器的基线作用挑战了现有预训练假设，值得进一步探讨。

title: HAP Networks for the Future: Applications in Sensing, Computing, and Communication
summary: High Altitude Platforms (HAPs) are a major advancement in non-terrestrial networks, offering broad coverage and unique capabilities. They form a vital link between satellite systems and terrestrial networks and play a key role in next-generation communication technologies. This study reviews HAP network applications, focusing on advanced airborne communications, integrated sensing, and airborne informatics. Our survey assesses the current state of HAP-centric applications by examining data processing, network performance, computational and storage requirements, economic feasibility, and regulatory challenges. The analysis highlights the evolving role of HAPs in global communication and identifies future research directions to support their deployment.

AI.title_translation: 面向未来的高空平台网络：在感知、计算与通信中的应用
AI.tldr: 本文综述高空平台（HAP）在非地面网络中的角色及其在通信、感知和空中信息处理方面的应用现状与未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 高空平台作为连接卫星与地面网络的关键环节，在下一代广域通信、感知与计算中具有独特优势，但其应用现状、技术需求、经济与监管问题尚需系统梳理与分析，以指导未来部署与研究。
AI.method: 采用综述/调查研究方法，从文献与现有实践出发，围绕高空平台在空中通信、综合感知与空中信息学方面的应用，系统评估其数据处理方式、网络性能、计算与存储需求、经济可行性以及监管挑战。
AI.result: 综述表明，高空平台在全球通信中的角色正在演变，具备广覆盖和独特能力；通过对数据处理、网络性能与资源需求等方面的分析，识别出当前高空平台网络的技术与非技术瓶颈，并提出相应的未来研究方向。未提及具体量化指标或实验结果，故整体结论偏定性评估。具体数值与案例细节：Not mentioned in abstract
AI.conclusion: 高空平台网络正成为非地面网络中连接卫星与地面系统的关键组成部分，在高级空中通信、集成感知和空中信息处理方面具有广阔前景，但其大规模部署仍面临计算与存储资源配置、经济可行性以及监管等多重挑战，需要沿着文中提出的研究方向进一步深入。
AI.translation: 高空平台（HAP）是在非地面网络中的一项重要进展，能够提供广域覆盖和独特能力。它们在卫星系统与地面网络之间形成关键连接，并在下一代通信技术中发挥重要作用。本研究回顾了高空平台网络的应用，重点关注高级空中通信、集成感知以及空中信息学。我们的综述通过考察数据处理、网络性能、计算与存储需求、经济可行性和监管挑战，评估了以高空平台为中心的应用现状。分析结果突出了高空平台在全球通信中不断演变的角色，并识别出支持其部署所需的未来研究方向。
AI.summary: 本文对高空平台网络在非地面通信体系中的应用进行了系统综述。作者重点讨论了高空平台在高级空中通信、集成感知和空中信息学等方面的作用，从数据处理模式、网络性能、计算与存储需求、经济可行性以及监管障碍等多个维度评估当前技术与应用现状。研究认为，高空平台正从简单补充逐步演变为连接卫星与地面网络的关键基础设施，同时也面临资源配置、成本与监管等多方面挑战。文章在此基础上归纳并提出了若干未来研究方向，以促进高空平台网络的大规模部署和应用拓展。
AI.keywords: 高空平台, 非地面网络, 空中通信, 集成感知, 空中信息学, 数据处理, 网络性能, 计算与存储需求, 经济可行性, 监管挑战, 未来研究方向
AI.comments: 该工作属于面向高空平台网络的综述性研究，重点在于全景式梳理应用场景和挑战，而非提出新算法或具体系统原型。文中强调多维度评估（性能、资源、经济、监管），有助于形成跨学科视角。但摘要未给出具体评估方法、指标或案例，定量结论和实践细节需查阅正文。适合作为了解高空平台在通信、感知与计算融合方向整体版图的入口文献。

title: LATA: Laplacian-Assisted Transductive Adaptation for Conformal Uncertainty in Medical VLMs
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) are strong zero-shot recognizers for medical imaging, but their reliability under domain shift hinges on calibrated uncertainty with guarantees. Split conformal prediction (SCP) offers finite-sample coverage, yet prediction sets often become large (low efficiency) and class-wise coverage unbalanced-high class-conditioned coverage gap (CCV), especially in few-shot, imbalanced regimes; moreover, naively adapting to calibration labels breaks exchangeability and voids guarantees. We propose \texttt{\textbf{LATA}} (Laplacian-Assisted Transductive Adaptation), a \textit{training- and label-free} refinement that operates on the joint calibration and test pool by smoothing zero-shot probabilities over an image-image k-NN graph using a small number of CCCP mean-field updates, preserving SCP validity via a deterministic transform. We further introduce a \textit{failure-aware} conformal score that plugs into the vision-language uncertainty (ViLU) framework, providing instance-level difficulty and label plausibility to improve prediction set efficiency and class-wise balance at fixed coverage. \texttt{\textbf{LATA}} is black-box (no VLM updates), compute-light (windowed transduction, no backprop), and includes an optional prior knob that can run strictly label-free or, if desired, in a label-informed variant using calibration marginals once. Across \textbf{three} medical VLMs and \textbf{nine} downstream tasks, \texttt{\textbf{LATA}} consistently reduces set size and CCV while matching or tightening target coverage, outperforming prior transductive baselines and narrowing the gap to label-using methods, while using far less compute. Comprehensive ablations and qualitative analyses show that \texttt{\textbf{LATA}} sharpens zero-shot predictions without compromising exchangeability.

AI.title_translation: LATA：用于医学视觉-语言模型保形不确定性的拉普拉斯辅助迁移自适应方法
AI.tldr: 提出无需训练和标签的LATA方法，在保持保形预测覆盖率保证的前提下，通过图上传播和失效感知评分显著提升医学VLM在域移场景下的不确定性校准效率与类别均衡性。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉-语言模型在零样本识别上很强，但在域移下需要既有理论保证又高效率且类别均衡的不确定性校准；现有分割保形预测虽有有限样本覆盖率保证，却存在预测集合过大、类条件覆盖率不平衡，以及直接利用校准标签进行自适应会破坏可交换性从而失去保证的问题。
AI.method: 提出LATA（Laplacian-Assisted Transductive Adaptation）：在联合的校准+测试样本池上构建图像-图像k近邻图，对零样本概率进行拉普拉斯平滑，通过少量CCCP均值场更新以确定性方式变换概率，从而保持SCP有效性；同时在ViLU框架中引入失效感知保形评分，提供实例级难度与标签可信度信息，用于提升预测集的效率与类间平衡。该方法黑盒且轻量，无需更新VLM、不做反向传播，可纯无标签运行，也可选用一次性使用校准边缘分布的先验以获得标签指导变体。
AI.result: 在三个医学VLM和九个下游任务上，LATA在匹配或收紧目标覆盖率的同时，一致性地减小预测集大小和类条件覆盖率差距，优于现有迁移式基线，接近甚至缩小与需要标签的方法之间的性能差距，并以显著更低计算成本实现这一点；消融和定性分析表明，LATA能在不破坏可交换性的前提下锐化零样本预测。
AI.conclusion: LATA证明，利用基于图的拉普拉斯平滑和失效感知保形评分，可以在不训练、不使用额外标签且保持保形预测理论保证的前提下，显著提升医学VLM在域移条件下的不确定性校准效率与类别均衡性。
AI.translation: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）在医学影像的零样本识别中表现出色，但在域移条件下，其可靠性依赖于具有保证的、校准良好的不确定性。分割保形预测（SCP）提供了有限样本覆盖率保证，但其预测集合往往过大（效率低），且在类别层面的覆盖率不平衡——即较高的类条件覆盖率间隙（CCV），这一问题在小样本和类别不平衡场景下尤为严重；此外，直接对校准标签进行自适应会破坏可交换性，从而使理论保证失效。我们提出LATA（Laplacian-Assisted Transductive Adaptation），这是一种无需训练和标签的改进方法，它在联合的校准集和测试集上工作，通过在图像-图像k近邻图上平滑零样本概率，并使用少量CCCP均值场更新，从而实现确定性的变换，保持SCP的有效性。我们进一步在ViLU（vision-language uncertainty）框架中引入一种“失效感知”的保形评分，在实例层面提供难度和标签可信度信息，以提高在固定覆盖率下预测集合的效率和类别间平衡性。LATA为黑盒方法（不更新VLM）、计算开销小（窗口化迁移，无反向传播），并包含一个可选的先验调节项：既可以完全无标签运行，也可以在需要时利用一次性计算的校准边缘分布，形成标签知情变体。在三个医学VLM和九个下游任务上，LATA在保持或增强目标覆盖率的同时，一致性地减小预测集合大小和CCV，优于以往的迁移式基线，并以远低于其的计算成本缩小与使用标签方法之间的差距。全面的消融和定性分析表明，LATA能够在不损害可交换性的情况下锐化零样本预测。
AI.summary: 本文针对医学VLM在域移场景下的保形不确定性校准问题，提出拉普拉斯辅助迁移自适应方法LATA。该方法在校准+测试样本上构建kNN图，对零样本预测概率进行图拉普拉斯平滑，并通过少量CCCP均值场迭代以确定性方式调整概率，从而在不破坏SCP可交换性假设的前提下改进预测。作者还设计了失效感知保形评分并将其嵌入ViLU框架，用于刻画样本难度和标签可信度，以在固定覆盖率下缩小预测集并减小类别覆盖率差异。LATA为黑盒、轻量级，无需额外训练，可完全无标签或弱标签先验运行。实验在3个医学VLM、9个任务上表明，该方法显著提升预测集效率和类条件均衡性，同时保持甚至收紧覆盖率，相比现有迁移式基线和需要标签的方法更具性能与计算优势。
AI.keywords: 医学视觉-语言模型, 保形预测, 分割保形预测, 不确定性校准, 迁移自适应, 拉普拉斯平滑, 图k近邻, ViLU, 类条件覆盖率差距, 零样本学习
AI.comments: 方法设计紧贴保形预测的可交换性与有限样本保证，通过确定性图平滑规避了常见的标签自适应陷阱；但摘要未披露任务类型、具体性能增益幅度及对极端长尾或多模态输入的适应性，后续应关注在更大规模医学数据和真实临床工作流中的可扩展性。

title: IRIS: Learning-Driven Task-Specific Cinema Robot Arm for Visuomotor Motion Control
summary: Robotic camera systems enable dynamic, repeatable motion beyond human capabilities, yet their adoption remains limited by the high cost and operational complexity of industrial-grade platforms. We present the Intelligent Robotic Imaging System (IRIS), a task-specific 6-DOF manipulator designed for autonomous, learning-driven cinematic motion control. IRIS integrates a lightweight, fully 3D-printed hardware design with a goal-conditioned visuomotor imitation learning framework based on Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT). The system learns object-aware and perceptually smooth camera trajectories directly from human demonstrations, eliminating the need for explicit geometric programming. The complete platform costs under $1,000 USD, supports a 1.5 kg payload, and achieves approximately 1 mm repeatability. Real-world experiments demonstrate accurate trajectory tracking, reliable autonomous execution, and generalization across diverse cinematic motions.

AI.title_translation: IRIS：基于学习驱动的面向特定任务的电影机器人手臂，用于视觉运动控制
AI.tldr: IRIS是一个低成本、3D打印的6自由度机器人手臂，通过基于Transformer的动作块模仿学习框架，实现无需几何编程的自主电影运动控制，成本低于1000美元，负载1.5千克，精度约1毫米。
AI.motivation: 现有工业级机器人相机系统成本高、操作复杂，限制了其广泛应用，IRIS旨在提供一种低成本、易用的自主电影运动控制解决方案。
AI.method: IRIS采用完全3D打印的硬件设计，并集成了基于Transformer的动作块（Action Chunking with Transformers, ACT）的目标条件视觉运动模仿学习框架，从人类演示中学习目标感知且感知平滑的相机轨迹。
AI.result: 该平台成本低于1000美元，负载1.5千克，重复精度约1毫米。真实世界实验显示，IRIS能实现精确轨迹跟踪、可靠的自主执行，并能泛化到多种电影运动中。
AI.conclusion: IRIS成功展示了一种低成本、基于学习的电影机器人手臂，能够从人类演示中自主生成平滑相机轨迹，无需显式几何编程，具有实用性和推广潜力。
AI.translation: 智能机器人成像系统（IRIS）是一个为自主、学习驱动的电影运动控制设计的面向特定任务的6自由度机械臂。IRIS整合了轻量级、完全3D打印的硬件设计和基于Transformer动作块的目标条件视觉运动模仿学习框架。该系统直接从人类演示中学习目标感知且感知平滑的相机轨迹，无需显式几何编程。完整平台成本低于1000美元，支持1.5千克负载，达到约1毫米重复精度。真实世界实验证明了准确的轨迹跟踪、可靠的自主执行以及对多样化电影运动的泛化能力。
AI.summary: IRIS是一种低成本、3D打印的6自由度机器人手臂，用于自主电影运动控制。它通过基于Transformer的动作块模仿学习框架，从人类演示中学习相机轨迹，无需几何编程，成本低于1000美元，负载1.5千克，精度约1毫米，并能在真实世界场景中泛化多种运动。
AI.keywords: 机器人相机系统, 视觉运动控制, 模仿学习, 3D打印, 低成本, 自主运动, 电影机器人, 动作块Transformer
AI.comments: 该工作创新地结合了3D打印硬件和模仿学习框架，显著降低了电影机器人系统的成本和复杂性。强调从演示中学习而非显式编程，这可能提高易用性和适应性。成本低于1000美元和约1毫米精度是突出优势，但未讨论长期耐用性或大规模生产可行性。

title: Informative Trains: A Memory-Efficient Journey to a Self-Stabilizing Leader Election Algorithm in Anonymous Graphs
summary:
We study the self-stabilizing leader election problem in anonymous $n$-nodes networks. Achieving self-stabilization with low space memory complexity is particularly challenging, and designing space-optimal leader election algorithms remains an open problem for general graphs. In deterministic settings, it is known that $Ω(\log \log n)$ bits of memory per node are necessary [Blin et al., Disc. Math. \& Theor. Comput. Sci., 2023], while in probabilistic settings the same lower bound holds for some values of $n$, but only for an unfair scheduler [Beauquier et al., PODC 1999]. Several deterministic and probabilistic protocols have been proposed in models ranging from the state model to the population protocols. However, to the best of our knowledge, existing solutions either require $Ω(\log n)$ bits of memory per node for general worst case graphs, or achieve low state complexity only under restricted network topologies such as rings, trees, or bounded-degree graphs.
  In this paper, we present a probabilistic self-stabilizing leader election algorithm for arbitrary anonymous networks that uses $O(\log \log n)$ bits of memory per node. Our algorithm operates in the state model under a synchronous scheduler and assumes knowledge of a global parameter $N = Θ(\log n)$. We show that, under our protocol, the system converges almost surely to a stable configuration with a unique leader and stabilizes within $O(\mathrm{poly}(n))$ rounds with high probability. To achieve $O(\log \log n)$ bits of memory, our algorithm keeps transmitting information after convergence, i.e. it does not verify the silence property. Moreover, like most works in the field, our algorithm does not provide explicit termination detection (i.e., nodes do not detect when the algorithm has converged).

AI.title_translation: 信息列车：一个在匿名图中实现自稳定领导者选举算法的内存高效之旅
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种概率性自稳定领导者选举算法，适用于任意匿名网络，每个节点仅使用O(log log n)位内存，在同步调度器下运行，收敛时间为O(poly(n))轮，高概率成功。
AI.motivation: 在匿名网络中，实现低内存复杂度的自稳定领导者选举是一个开放问题，现有方案要么需要O(log n)位内存（针对一般最坏情况图），要么仅适用于受限拓扑（如环、树或有界度图）。本文旨在设计一个适用于任意匿名网络的算法，仅使用O(log log n)位内存。
AI.method: 提出了一种概率性自稳定领导者选举算法，在状态模型下运行，采用同步调度器，并假设已知全局参数N = Θ(log n)。算法通过持续传输信息（不满足静默属性）来实现内存高效性，且不提供显式终止检测。
AI.result: 算法以概率1（几乎必然）收敛到具有唯一领导者的稳定配置，并以高概率在O(poly(n))轮内稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该算法首次实现了在任意匿名网络中，每个节点仅使用O(log log n)位内存的自稳定领导者选举，突破了现有方案的内存限制。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文针对匿名网络中自稳定领导者选举的内存高效挑战，提出了一种概率算法，每个节点仅需O(log log n)位内存，在同步调度下以高概率在多项式轮数内收敛到唯一领导者配置，适用于任意拓扑，但需已知全局参数N且不提供终止检测。
AI.keywords: 自稳定, 领导者选举, 匿名图, 内存复杂度, 概率算法, 状态模型, 同步调度
AI.comments: 该工作显著降低了内存需求，接近已知下界Ω(log log n)，但依赖同步调度器和全局参数知识，且不满足静默属性，可能影响实际应用中的能耗效率。

title: Using LLMs for Knowledge Component-level Correctness Labeling in Open-ended Coding Problems
summary: Fine-grained skill representations, commonly referred to as knowledge components (KCs), are fundamental to many approaches in student modeling and learning analytics. However, KC-level correctness labels are rarely available in real-world datasets, especially for open-ended programming tasks where solutions typically involve multiple KCs simultaneously. Simply propagating problem-level correctness to all associated KCs obscures partial mastery and often leads to poorly fitted learning curves. To address this challenge, we propose an automated framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to label KC-level correctness directly from student-written code. Our method assesses whether each KC is correctly applied and further introduces a temporal context-aware Code-KC mapping mechanism to better align KCs with individual student code. We evaluate the resulting KC-level correctness labels in terms of learning curve fit and predictive performance using the power law of practice and the Additive Factors Model. Experimental results show that our framework leads to learning curves that are more consistent with cognitive theory and improves predictive performance, compared to baselines. Human evaluation further demonstrates substantial agreement between LLM and expert annotations.

AI.title_translation: 在开放式编程问题中利用大型语言模型进行知识组件级别的正确性标注
AI.tldr: 提出基于大型语言模型的框架，自动标注学生编程代码中知识组件的正确性，提升学习曲线拟合和预测性能。
AI.motivation: 真实数据集中缺乏知识组件级别的正确性标注，尤其对于开放式编程任务，简单传播问题级别正确性会掩盖部分掌握情况，导致学习曲线拟合不佳。
AI.method: 利用大型语言模型自动从学生代码中标注知识组件级别的正确性，引入时间上下文感知的代码-知识组件映射机制以更好地对齐。
AI.result: 实验表明，该框架产生的学习曲线更符合认知理论，提高了预测性能，并与专家标注有较高一致性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的自动化框架能有效解决知识组件级别标注缺失问题，为学习分析和学生建模提供更精细的数据支持。
AI.translation: 知识组件（KC）级别的正确性标签在现实数据集中很少见，特别是在开放式编程任务中，解决方案通常同时涉及多个知识组件。简单地将问题级别的正确性传播到所有关联的知识组件会掩盖部分掌握情况，并常常导致拟合不良的学习曲线。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个自动化框架，利用大型语言模型（LLM）直接根据学生编写的代码标注知识组件级别的正确性。我们的方法评估每个知识组件是否正确应用，并进一步引入了时间上下文感知的代码-知识组件映射机制，以更好地将知识组件与个别学生代码对齐。我们使用练习幂律和可加因子模型评估了生成的知识组件级别正确性标签的学习曲线拟合和预测性能。实验结果表明，与基线相比，我们的框架产生的学习曲线更符合认知理论，并提高了预测性能。人工评估进一步显示了大型语言模型和专家标注之间的高度一致性。
AI.summary: 本文针对开放式编程任务中知识组件级别正确性标签缺失的问题，提出一个基于大型语言模型的自动化标注框架。该框架通过分析学生代码，评估每个知识组件的正确应用，并引入时间上下文感知的映射机制来优化对齐。实验评估表明，该方法能生成更符合认知理论的学习曲线，提高预测准确性，且与专家标注有良好一致性，为精细化的学习分析和学生建模提供了有效工具。
AI.keywords: 知识组件, 大型语言模型, 开放式编程问题, 正确性标注, 学习曲线, 时间上下文感知
AI.comments: 论文创新性地将大型语言模型应用于教育领域的知识组件标注，解决了真实数据中的标注难题，并通过实验验证了其有效性和一致性，具有实际应用潜力。但摘要未提及具体的数据集规模、模型细节或潜在局限性。

title: Evaluating Chain-of-Thought Reasoning through Reusability and Verifiability
summary: In multi-agent IR pipelines for tasks such as search and ranking, LLM-based agents exchange intermediate reasoning in terms of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) with each other. Current CoT evaluation narrowly focuses on target task accuracy. However, this metric fails to assess the quality or utility of the reasoning process itself. To address this limitation, we introduce two novel measures: reusability and verifiability. We decouple CoT generation from execution using a Thinker-Executor framework. Reusability measures how easily an Executor can reuse the Thinker's CoT. Verifiability measures how frequently an Executor can match the Thinker's answer using the CoT. We evaluated four Thinker models against a committee of ten Executor models across five benchmarks. Our results reveal that reusability and verifiability do not correlate with standard accuracy, exposing a blind spot in current accuracy-based leaderboards for reasoning capability. Surprisingly, we find that CoTs from specialized reasoning models are not consistently more reusable or verifiable than those from general-purpose LLMs like Llama and Gemma.

AI.title_translation: 基于可复用性与可验证性评估思维链推理
AI.tldr: 提出可复用性和可验证性两个新指标，在Thinker-Executor框架下评估思维链本身的质量，发现其与任务准确率无关，且专用推理模型的CoT未必优于通用LLM。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT评估仅关注任务准确率，无法衡量推理过程本身的质量与实用性，需补充对推理链本身价值的度量。
AI.method: 引入Thinker-Executor解耦框架：Thinker生成CoT，Executor独立执行；定义可复用性（Executor重用CoT的便利度）和可验证性（Executor凭CoT与Thinker答案一致率）；用4个Thinker与10个Executor在5个基准上实验。
AI.result: 可复用性与可验证性同标准准确率无相关性；专用推理模型的CoT在这两项指标上并不持续优于Llama、Gemma等通用模型。
AI.conclusion: 准确率导向的排行榜存在盲区，评估推理能力需额外考察CoT的可复用性与可验证性；通用模型亦能产出高质量推理链。
AI.translation: 在多智能体信息检索流程中，LLM智能体以思维链形式交换中间推理。现有评估仅关注任务准确率，无法衡量推理过程本身的质量。本文提出可复用性与可验证性两项新指标，并在Thinker-Executor框架下解耦CoT生成与执行。实验显示这两项指标与准确率无相关，且专用模型未必优于通用模型。
AI.summary: 本文针对CoT评估盲区，提出可复用性与可验证性指标，在Thinker-Executor框架下系统评估推理链本身质量。实验表明这些指标与任务准确率脱钩，且通用LLM的CoT质量可媲美专用推理模型，呼吁社区超越准确率排行榜全面评估推理能力。
AI.keywords: 思维链评估;可复用性;可验证性;多智能体系统;Thinker-Executor框架;大语言模型
AI.comments: 摘要未提及具体基准、模型规模或实验代码是否公开。

title: Learning to Stay Safe: Adaptive Regularization Against Safety Degradation during Fine-Tuning
summary: Instruction-following language models are trained to be helpful and safe, yet their safety behavior can deteriorate under benign fine-tuning and worsen under adversarial updates. Existing defenses often offer limited protection or force a trade-off between safety and utility. We introduce a training framework that adapts regularization in response to safety risk, enabling models to remain aligned throughout fine-tuning. To estimate safety risk at training time, we explore two distinct approaches: a judge-based Safety Critic that assigns high-level harm scores to training batches, and an activation-based risk predictor built with a lightweight classifier trained on intermediate model activations to estimate harmful intent. Each approach provides a risk signal that is used to constrain updates deemed higher risk to remain close to a safe reference policy, while lower-risk updates proceed with standard training. We empirically verify that harmful intent signals are predictable from pre-generation activations and that judge scores provide effective high-recall safety guidance. Across multiple model families and attack scenarios, adaptive regularization with either risk estimation approach consistently lowers attack success rate compared to standard fine-tuning, preserves downstream performance, and adds no inference-time cost. This work demonstrates a principled mechanism for maintaining safety without sacrificing utility.

AI.title_translation: 学会保持安全：针对微调过程中安全性退化的自适应正则化
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于安全风险自适应调整正则化强度的微调框架，在多种模型与攻击场景下显著降低攻击成功率，同时基本不牺牲下游任务性能且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 指令跟随大模型在预训练对齐后，经过看似良性的微调也可能出现安全行为退化，在对抗式更新下更为严重；现有防御要么保护有限，要么在安全与有用性之间做出明显权衡，因此需要一种在微调过程中持续维持安全性的机制。
AI.method: 提出一个在微调过程中根据安全风险自适应调整正则化强度的训练框架：首先通过两类方法估计训练批次的安全风险——(1) 基于裁判模型的 Safety Critic，对训练批次打出高层次危害分数；(2) 基于中间激活的轻量级分类器，从生成前的模型激活预测有害意图。然后利用该风险信号，对被判为高风险的更新施加强约束，使其参数变化保持接近安全参考策略，而对低风险更新则采用标准训练，从而动态平衡对齐与学习效用。
AI.result: 实证结果表明：有害意图信号可从生成前的中间激活中可靠预测，裁判评分能提供高召回的安全指导；在多种模型家族与攻击场景中，两种风险估计方法驱动的自适应正则化均能稳定降低攻击成功率，相比标准微调更好保持安全性，同时保留下游任务性能且推理阶段无额外计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 利用训练时的风险估计信号自适应地约束参数更新，是在不牺牲模型有用性的前提下保持和增强安全性的有效原则化机制，适用于多种模型与微调攻击场景。
AI.translation: 指令跟随语言模型被训练得既有用又安全，但它们的安全行为在看似良性的微调下可能退化，并在对抗式更新下进一步恶化。现有防御往往只能提供有限保护，或迫使在安全与实用之间进行权衡。我们提出一个训练框架，可根据安全风险自适应地调整正则化，使模型在整个微调过程中保持对齐。为在训练时估计安全风险，我们探索两种不同方法：一种是基于裁判模型的 Safety Critic，对训练批次赋予高层次的危害分数；另一种是基于激活的风险预测器，使用在中间模型激活上训练的轻量级分类器来估计有害意图。每种方法都提供一个风险信号，用于约束被视为高风险的更新，使其保持接近一个安全参考策略，而让低风险更新按标准训练进行。我们在实证中验证：有害意图信号可从生成前的激活中预测，且裁判分数能提供有效且高召回的安全引导。在多种模型家族和攻击场景下，与标准微调相比，采用任一风险估计方法的自适应正则化都能持续降低攻击成功率，保持下游任务表现，并且不增加推理阶段的成本。该工作展示了一种不牺牲实用性即可维护安全性的有原则机制。
AI.summary: 本文关注指令跟随大模型在后续微调时的“对齐退化”问题：即便是表面上良性的微调过程，也可能削弱原有的安全约束，对抗式更新则会进一步放大风险。作者提出一个核心思路：在微调过程中实时估计当前训练批次的安全风险，并据此动态调节正则化强度——风险越高，参数更新就越被限制在接近某个安全参考策略的邻域内；风险较低时则允许模型以常规方式学习，避免不必要的性能损失。为实现这一点，文中设计了两种风险估计路径：（1）借助一个“安全裁判”模型，对训练批次给出高层次的危害评分；（2）训练一个轻量级分类器，从模型生成前的中间激活中预测是否存在有害意图。实验显示，有害意图可在生成前从激活中被可靠读出，裁判模型也能提供高召回的安全信号；在多种模型家族和攻击场景下，该自适应正则化框架显著降低了攻击成功率，同时基本保持下游任务性能，不增加推理开销。总体上，作者证明了“一边学新任务，一边动态拉回安全参考策略”的范式，是缓解微调阶段安全退化的可行且高效的途径。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 安全对齐, 微调, 自适应正则化, 风险估计, Safety Critic, 中间激活, 有害意图检测, 攻击成功率
AI.comments: 文章提出的关键创新在于把训练时的安全风险估计与参数更新强度直接绑定，从而在保持模型能力的同时抑制高风险更新；两条互补的风险估计路径（裁判打分与激活分类）兼顾了语义层和内部表征层的信息。不过摘要未说明使用的具体数据集、评测基准与攻击类型的细节，也未讨论在极端分布偏移或裁判/分类器本身被绕过时的潜在失效模式。

title: KLong: Training LLM Agent for Extremely Long-horizon Tasks
summary: This paper introduces KLong, an open-source LLM agent trained to solve extremely long-horizon tasks. The principle is to first cold-start the model via trajectory-splitting SFT, then scale it via progressive RL training. Specifically, we first activate basic agentic abilities of a base model with a comprehensive SFT recipe. Then, we introduce Research-Factory, an automated pipeline that generates high-quality training data by collecting research papers and constructing evaluation rubrics. Using this pipeline, we build thousands of long-horizon trajectories distilled from Claude 4.5 Sonnet (Thinking). To train with these extremely long trajectories, we propose a new trajectory-splitting SFT, which preserves early context, progressively truncates later context, and maintains overlap between sub-trajectories. In addition, to further improve long-horizon task-solving capability, we propose a novel progressive RL, which schedules training into multiple stages with progressively extended timeouts. Experiments demonstrate the superiority and generalization of KLong, as shown in Figure 1. Notably, our proposed KLong (106B) surpasses Kimi K2 Thinking (1T) by 11.28% on PaperBench, and the performance improvement generalizes to other coding benchmarks like SWE-bench Verified and MLE-bench.

AI.title_translation: KLong：用于极端长视野任务训练的大模型智能体
AI.tldr: 提出开源智能体 KLong，通过轨迹切分监督微调和渐进式强化学习，显著提升极长序列任务的解决能力，并在多项基准上超越更大规模模型。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在极长视野、长时推理与复杂任务分解上能力不足，尤其是在需要长时间规划和多步推理的研究与工程任务中表现有限，亟需专门的训练方法增强长视野智能体能力。
AI.method: 1）先用“轨迹切分 SFT”对基础模型进行全面的代理式能力激活：从长轨迹中保留早期上下文、渐进截断后段并保持子轨迹重叠；2）提出 Research-Factory 自动数据生成流水线，收集论文并构造评测 rubric，从 Claude 4.5 Sonnet（Thinking）蒸馏出数千条长视野轨迹；3）在此基础上进行多阶段、超时时间逐步延长的渐进式强化学习训练，以持续增强长视野任务解决能力；4）构建 106B 参数规模的 KLong 智能体。
AI.result: 实验表明 KLong 在长视野任务上具有更优性能与泛化能力：KLong（106B）在 PaperBench 上比 Kimi K2 Thinking（1T）高出 11.28%，且在 SWE-bench Verified 和 MLE-bench 等编码基准上也获得性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合轨迹切分监督微调、自动化高质量长轨迹数据生成流水线以及渐进式强化学习，可以在较小参数规模下训练出在极长视野任务上优于更大模型的 LLM 智能体，且性能提升能够泛化到多种实际基准任务。
AI.translation: 本文提出了 KLong，一个用于解决极端长视野任务的开源大模型智能体。其核心原则是先通过轨迹切分监督微调进行冷启动，再通过渐进式强化学习进行扩展。具体而言，我们首先使用一套全面的监督微调配方激活基础模型的基本代理能力。随后，我们提出 Research-Factory，这一自动化流水线通过收集研究论文并构造评估量表来生成高质量训练数据。借助该流水线，我们构建了数千条从 Claude 4.5 Sonnet（Thinking）蒸馏得到的长视野轨迹。为能够利用这些极长轨迹进行训练，我们提出了一种新的轨迹切分监督微调方法，该方法保留早期上下文、逐步截断后期上下文，并在子轨迹之间保持重叠。此外，为进一步提升长视野任务求解能力，我们提出了一种新型的渐进式强化学习，将训练调度为多个阶段，并逐步延长超时时间。实验结果如图 1 所示，证明了 KLong 的优越性和泛化能力。值得注意的是，我们提出的 KLong（106B）在 PaperBench 上比 Kimi K2 Thinking（1T）高出 11.28%，且这一性能提升可泛化至 SWE-bench Verified 和 MLE-bench 等其他编码基准。
AI.summary: 本文面向极端长视野任务提出开源智能体 KLong，通过“先 SFT 再 RL”的两阶段框架构建长时推理能力。作者设计 Research-Factory 自动流水线，从论文与评价量表生成高质量长轨迹，并提出保留早期上下文、重叠切分的轨迹切分 SFT，以及超时逐步延长的渐进式 RL。实验证明 KLong-106B 在 PaperBench 上明显优于参数更大的 Kimi K2 Thinking-1T，并在 SWE-bench Verified 和 MLE-bench 等编码任务上也取得可观提升，显示其强长视野与跨任务泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 长视野任务, LLM 智能体, 轨迹切分监督微调, 渐进式强化学习, Research-Factory, 代码基准, PaperBench, Claude 4.5 Sonnet 蒸馏
AI.comments: 工作亮点在于体系化解决极长轨迹训练难题：一是通过自动数据生成流水线和从强闭源模型蒸馏获得高质量长视野数据，二是通过特殊的轨迹切分策略和阶段式 RL 训练有效利用这些数据并控制计算成本。依赖 Claude 4.5 作为教师模型意味着能力上有一定上限对齐，但结果显示在相同或更小参数规模下可以超越现有大模型代理，在实际工程和研究型长任务场景中具有较强应用潜力。

title: MASPO: Unifying Gradient Utilization, Probability Mass, and Signal Reliability for Robust and Sample-Efficient LLM Reasoning
summary: Existing Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) algorithms, such as GRPO, rely on rigid, uniform, and symmetric trust region mechanisms that are fundamentally misaligned with the complex optimization dynamics of Large Language Models (LLMs). In this paper, we identify three critical challenges in these methods: (1) inefficient gradient utilization caused by the binary cutoff of hard clipping, (2) insensitive probability mass arising from uniform ratio constraints that ignore the token distribution, and (3) asymmetric signal reliability stemming from the disparate credit assignment ambiguity between positive and negative samples. To bridge these gaps, we propose Mass-Adaptive Soft Policy Optimization (MASPO), a unified framework designed to harmonize these three dimensions. MASPO integrates a differentiable soft Gaussian gating to maximize gradient utility, a mass-adaptive limiter to balance exploration across the probability spectrum, and an asymmetric risk controller to align update magnitudes with signal confidence. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MASPO serves as a robust, all-in-one RLVR solution, significantly outperforming strong baselines. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ma1/README.md.

AI.title_translation: MASPO：统一梯度利用、概率质量和信号可靠性，以实现鲁棒且样本高效的大语言模型推理
AI.tldr: MASPO是一个统一的强化学习框架，通过软高斯门控、质量自适应限制器和非对称风险控制器，解决了现有RLVR算法在梯度利用、概率分布和信号可靠性方面的缺陷，显著提升LLM推理的鲁棒性和样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）算法（如GRPO）使用僵硬、均匀且对称的信任区域机制，与大型语言模型（LLM）的复杂优化动态不匹配，导致梯度利用效率低、概率分布不敏感和信号可靠性不对称的问题，需要改进以实现更鲁棒和样本高效的推理。
AI.method: 提出质量自适应软策略优化（MASPO），一个统一框架，整合了三个组件：可微分的软高斯门控以最大化梯度效用，质量自适应限制器以平衡概率谱上的探索，以及非对称风险控制器以使更新幅度与信号置信度对齐。
AI.result: 广泛评估表明，MASPO作为一个鲁棒的全能RLVR解决方案，显著优于强基线模型。
AI.conclusion: MASPO通过统一处理梯度利用、概率质量和信号可靠性，为LLM推理提供了一个有效的强化学习框架，解决了现有方法的局限性。
AI.translation: MASPO：统一梯度利用、概率质量和信号可靠性，以实现鲁棒且样本高效的大语言模型推理。
AI.summary: 本论文针对现有RLVR算法在LLM优化中的问题，提出了MASPO框架，通过软高斯门控、质量自适应限制器和非对称风险控制器改进梯度利用、概率分布和信号可靠性，实验证明其优于基线，代码已开源。
AI.keywords: 强化学习，可验证奖励，大型语言模型，梯度利用，概率质量，信号可靠性，软策略优化
AI.comments: 论文提出了一个创新框架MASPO，直接针对RLVR算法的核心挑战，通过统一方法提升性能，但摘要未提及具体数据集或评估细节，需进一步验证通用性。

title: TopoSZp: Lightweight Topology-Aware Error-controlled Compression for Scientific Data
summary: Error-bounded lossy compression is essential for managing the massive data volumes produced by large-scale HPC simulations. While state-of-the-art compressors such as SZ and ZFP provide strong numerical error guarantees, they often fail to preserve topological structures (example, minima, maxima, and saddle points) that are critical for scientific analysis. Existing topology-aware compressors address this limitation but incur substantial computational overhead. We present TopoSZp, a lightweight, topology-aware, error-controlled lossy compressor that preserves critical points and their relationships while maintaining high compression and decompression performance. Built on the high-throughput SZp compressor, TopoSZp integrates efficient critical point detection, local ordering preservation, and targeted saddle point refinement, all within a relaxed but strictly enforced error bound. Experimental results on real-world scientific datasets show that TopoSZp achieves 3 to 100 times fewer non-preserved critical points, introduces no false positives or incorrect critical point types, and delivers 100 to 10000 times faster compression and 10 to 500 times faster decompression compared to existing topology-aware compressors, while maintaining competitive compression ratios.

AI.title_translation: TopoSZp：轻量级拓扑感知的科学数据误差控制压缩方法
AI.tldr: TopoSZp是一种高效的拓扑感知误差有损压缩器，能在保证压缩性能的同时，显著减少关键点（如极值点和鞍点）的丢失，且大幅提升压缩/解压速度。
AI.motivation: 现有误差有界有损压缩器（如SZ和ZFP）虽然提供数值误差保证，但难以保持科学分析所需的关键拓扑结构（如极值点和鞍点），而现有拓扑感知压缩器计算开销大。
AI.method: 基于高效压缩器SZp，TopoSZp集成高效关键点检测、局部顺序保持和针对性鞍点优化，在放宽但仍严格控制的误差范围内运行。
AI.result: 在真实科学数据集上，TopoSZp相比现有拓扑感知压缩器，非保留关键点减少3至100倍，无误报或关键点类型错误，压缩速度快100至10000倍，解压速度快10至500倍，压缩比保持竞争性。
AI.conclusion: TopoSZp是一种轻量级拓扑感知误差控制压缩方法，在保持高效压缩和解压性能的同时，显著提升了拓扑结构（关键点）的保存能力。
AI.translation: 摘要中已提供英文，此处不重复翻译。

title: A Theoretical Framework for Modular Learning of Robust Generative Models
summary: Training large-scale generative models is resource-intensive and relies heavily on heuristic dataset weighting. We address two fundamental questions: Can we train Large Language Models (LLMs) modularly-combining small, domain-specific experts to match monolithic performance-and can we do so robustly for any data mixture, eliminating heuristic tuning? We present a theoretical framework for modular generative modeling where a set of pre-trained experts are combined via a gating mechanism. We define the space of normalized gating functions, $G_{1}$, and formulate the problem as a minimax game to find a single robust gate that minimizes divergence to the worst-case data mixture. We prove the existence of such a robust gate using Kakutani's fixed-point theorem and show that modularity acts as a strong regularizer, with generalization bounds scaling with the lightweight gate's complexity. Furthermore, we prove that this modular approach can theoretically outperform models retrained on aggregate data, with the gap characterized by the Jensen-Shannon Divergence. Finally, we introduce a scalable Stochastic Primal-Dual algorithm and a Structural Distillation method for efficient inference. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets confirm that our modular architecture effectively mitigates gradient conflict and can robustly outperform monolithic baselines.

AI.title_translation: 模块化学习鲁棒生成模型的理论框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出一个理论框架，通过门控机制组合预训练小专家，无需启发式调参即可让模块化 LLM 在任意数据混合下达到与单体大模型相当甚至更优的鲁棒性与泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 训练大规模生成模型资源消耗巨大且依赖经验性的数据加权策略；作者希望回答能否以模块化方式组合小型领域专家来匹配单体性能，并彻底摆脱对数据混合的启发式调参。
AI.method: 定义归一化门控空间 G₁，将问题转化为极小极大博弈，利用 Kakutani 不动点定理证明存在对最坏数据混合仍鲁棒的单一门控；给出基于门控复杂度的泛化界，并提出可扩展的随机原始–对偶算法与结构蒸馏推理方法。
AI.result: 理论上证明模块化方法可超越在聚合数据上重训的模型，性能差距由 Jensen-Shannon 散度刻画；合成与真实数据实验显示该架构缓解梯度冲突并稳定优于单体基线。
AI.conclusion: 模块化不仅节省资源，还能作为强正则化器，在无需重训的前提下提供对任意数据混合都鲁棒的生成模型，并在理论与实证上均优于传统单体范式。
AI.translation: 训练大规模生成模型资源密集且严重依赖启发式数据集加权。我们回应两个根本问题：能否以模块化方式训练大语言模型——组合小型领域专家以匹敌单体性能——并能否对任意数据混合都鲁棒地实现，从而消除启发式调参？我们提出模块化生成建模的理论框架，通过门控机制组合一组预训练专家。我们定义归一化门控函数空间 G₁，并将问题表述为极小极大博弈，以寻找在最坏数据混合下仍能最小化散度的单一鲁棒门控。利用 Kakutani 不动点定理证明该鲁棒门控存在，并证明模块化充当强正则化器，其泛化界随轻量门控复杂度缩放。此外，我们理论上证明该模块化方法可优于在聚合数据上重训的模型，性能差距由 Jensen-Shannon 散度刻画。最后，我们提出可扩展的随机原始–对偶算法与结构蒸馏法实现高效推理。在合成与真实数据集上的实证结果证实，我们的模块化架构有效缓解梯度冲突，并能鲁棒地超越单体基线。
AI.summary: 本文构建模块化生成模型的理论框架：将多预训练专家通过门控组合，定义门控空间 G₁ 并转化为极小极大博弈，证明存在对最坏数据混合仍最优的鲁棒门控；给出泛化界并证明其可超越重训模型，提出随机原始–对偶算法与结构蒸馏，实验验证其鲁棒性与优越性。
AI.keywords: 模块化学习,鲁棒生成模型,大语言模型,门控机制,极小极大博弈,Jensen-Shannon 散度,泛化界,随机原始–对偶算法

title: GraphThinker: Reinforcing Video Reasoning with Event Graph Thinking
summary: Video reasoning requires understanding the causal relationships between events in a video. However, such relationships are often implicit and costly to annotate manually. While existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often infer event relations through dense captions or video summaries for video reasoning, such modeling still lacks causal understanding. Without explicit causal structure modeling within and across video events, these models suffer from hallucinations during the video reasoning. In this work, we propose GraphThinker, a reinforcement finetuning-based method that constructs structural event-level scene graphs and enhances visual grounding to jointly reduce hallucinations in video reasoning. Specifically, we first employ an MLLM to construct an event-based video scene graph (EVSG) that explicitly models both intra- and inter-event relations, and incorporate these formed scene graphs into the MLLM as an intermediate thinking process. We also introduce a visual attention reward during reinforcement finetuning, which strengthens video grounding and further mitigates hallucinations. We evaluate GraphThinker on two datasets, RexTime and VidHalluc, where it shows superior ability to capture object and event relations with more precise event localization, reducing hallucinations in video reasoning compared to prior methods.

AI.title_translation: GraphThinker：用事件图思维强化视频推理
AI.tldr: GraphThinker 通过强化微调构建事件级场景图并引入视觉注意力奖励，显著降低视频推理中的幻觉现象，在 RexTime 与 VidHalluc 上取得 SOTA 效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 仅依赖密集字幕或视频摘要进行推理，缺乏对事件间因果结构的显式建模，导致幻觉频发。作者希望以低成本方式引入因果理解，提升视频推理可靠性。
AI.method: 1) 用 MLLM 构建事件级视频场景图（EVSG），显式建模事件内与事件间关系；2) 将 EVSG 作为中间思维过程融入 MLLM；3) 在强化微调阶段引入视觉注意力奖励，增强视觉定位并抑制幻觉。
AI.result: 在 RexTime 与 VidHalluc 两个数据集上，GraphThinker 以更精准的事件定位捕捉对象与事件关系，显著降低幻觉，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将事件图结构作为思考过程并结合视觉注意力奖励的强化微调，可有效减少视频推理幻觉，为 MLLM 视频理解提供新范式。
AI.translation: 视频推理需理解视频中事件的因果关系，但这类关系通常隐含且人工标注代价高。现有 MLLM 多通过密集字幕或视频摘要推断事件关系，仍缺乏因果理解。若无显式因果结构建模，模型在视频推理时会出现幻觉。本文提出 GraphThinker，一种基于强化微调的方法，构建事件级场景图并增强视觉定位，共同减少幻觉。具体而言，先用 MLLM 构建事件视频场景图（EVSG）显式建模事件内外关系，并将其作为中间思考过程融入 MLLM；再在强化微调中引入视觉注意力奖励，强化视频定位并抑制幻觉。在 RexTime 与 VidHalluc 上的评估表明，GraphThinker 能更精准捕捉对象与事件关系，减少幻觉，优于先前方法。
AI.summary: GraphThinker 通过让 MLLM 先构建事件级场景图再回答，把因果结构显式化，并用视觉注意力奖励做强化微调，显著降低视频推理幻觉。
AI.keywords: 视频推理，事件图，幻觉抑制，强化微调，视觉注意力奖励
AI.comments: 方法简洁实用，把图结构当思维链的思路可迁移至其他多模态任务；未来可探索更复杂事件图或零样本场景。

title: RetouchIQ: MLLM Agents for Instruction-Based Image Retouching with Generalist Reward
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown great potential for extending vision-language reasoning to professional tool-based image editing, enabling intuitive and creative editing. A promising direction is to use reinforcement learning (RL) to enable MLLMs to reason about and execute optimal tool-use plans within professional image-editing software. However, training remains challenging due to the lack of reliable, verifiable reward signals that can reflect the inherently subjective nature of creative editing. In this work, we introduce RetouchIQ, a framework that performs instruction-based executable image editing through MLLM agents guided by a generalist reward model. RetouchIQ interprets user-specified editing intentions and generates corresponding, executable image adjustments, bridging high-level aesthetic goals with precise parameter control. To move beyond conventional, rule-based rewards that compute similarity against a fixed reference image using handcrafted metrics, we propose a generalist reward model, an RL fine-tuned MLLM that evaluates edited results through a set of generated metrics on a case-by-case basis. Then, the reward model provides scalar feedback through multimodal reasoning, enabling reinforcement learning with high-quality, instruction-consistent gradients. We curate an extended dataset with 190k instruction-reasoning pairs and establish a new benchmark for instruction-based image editing. Experiments show that RetouchIQ substantially improves both semantic consistency and perceptual quality over previous MLLM-based and diffusion-based editing systems. Our findings demonstrate the potential of generalist reward-driven MLLM agents as flexible, explainable, and executable assistants for professional image editing.

title: Revisiting Weight Regularization for Low-Rank Continual Learning
summary: Continual Learning (CL) with large-scale pre-trained models (PTMs) has recently gained wide attention, shifting the focus from training from scratch to continually adapting PTMs. This has given rise to a promising paradigm: parameter-efficient continual learning (PECL), where task interference is typically mitigated by assigning a task-specific module during training, such as low-rank adapters. However, weight regularization techniques, such as Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC)-a key strategy in CL-remain underexplored in this new paradigm. In this paper, we revisit weight regularization in low-rank CL as a new perspective for mitigating task interference in PECL. Unlike existing low-rank CL methods, we mitigate task interference by regularizing a shared low-rank update through EWC, thereby keeping the storage requirement and inference costs constant regardless of the number of tasks. Our proposed method EWC-LoRA leverages a low-rank representation to estimate parameter importance over the full-dimensional space. This design offers a practical, computational- and memory-efficient solution for CL with PTMs, and provides insights that may inform the broader application of regularization techniques within PECL. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of EWC-LoRA, achieving a stability-plasticity trade-off superior to existing low-rank CL approaches. These results indicate that, even under low-rank parameterizations, weight regularization remains an effective mechanism for mitigating task interference. Code is available at: https://github.com/yaoyz96/low-rank-cl.

AI.title_translation: 再探低秩持续学习中的权重正则化
AI.tldr: 本文提出EWC-LoRA，将弹性权重巩固(EWC)引入低秩适配器，通过共享低秩更新估计参数重要性，在保持恒定存储与推理成本的同时显著缓解任务干扰，实现优于现有低秩持续学习方法的稳定性-可塑性平衡。
AI.motivation: 尽管参数高效持续学习(PECL)通过为每个任务分配低秩适配器来缓解任务干扰，但权重正则化(如EWC)在这一新范式中尚未被充分探索。作者希望在不增加存储与推理开销的前提下，重新审视并验证权重正则化在低秩持续学习中的有效性。
AI.method: 提出EWC-LoRA：在共享的低秩更新上应用EWC正则化；利用低秩表示估计全维参数重要性，从而以计算与内存高效的方式对预训练大模型进行持续学习。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，EWC-LoRA在稳定性-可塑性权衡上优于现有低秩持续学习方法，证明即使采用低秩参数化，权重正则化仍能有效缓解任务干扰。
AI.conclusion: 在低秩持续学习中，权重正则化仍是缓解任务干扰的有效机制；EWC-LoRA为PECL提供了一种实用且资源高效的解决方案，并为正则化技术在PECL中的广泛应用提供新见解。
AI.translation: 本文重新审视低秩持续学习中的权重正则化，提出EWC-LoRA方法，通过共享低秩更新实施EWC，在恒定存储与推理成本下显著缓解任务干扰，实验结果优于现有低秩方法，表明权重正则化在低秩参数化下依然有效。
AI.summary: 针对参数高效持续学习(PECL)中权重正则化被忽视的问题，作者提出EWC-LoRA，将EWC应用于共享低秩更新以估计参数重要性，在存储与推理成本恒定的情况下显著降低任务干扰，实验显示其在多个基准上优于现有低秩持续学习方法，为PECL提供高效正则化新思路。
AI.keywords: 持续学习,权重正则化,弹性权重巩固,低秩适配器,参数高效微调,任务干扰,稳定性-可塑性权衡

title: ODESteer: A Unified ODE-Based Steering Framework for LLM Alignment
summary: Activation steering, or representation engineering, offers a lightweight approach to align large language models (LLMs) by manipulating their internal activations at inference time. However, current methods suffer from two key limitations: \textit{(i)} the lack of a unified theoretical framework for guiding the design of steering directions, and \textit{(ii)} an over-reliance on \textit{one-step steering} that fail to capture complex patterns of activation distributions. In this work, we propose a unified ordinary differential equations (ODEs)-based \textit{theoretical} framework for activation steering in LLM alignment. We show that conventional activation addition can be interpreted as a first-order approximation to the solution of an ODE. Based on this ODE perspective, identifying a steering direction becomes equivalent to designing a \textit{barrier function} from control theory. Derived from this framework, we introduce ODESteer, a kind of ODE-based steering guided by barrier functions, which shows \textit{empirical} advancement in LLM alignment. ODESteer identifies steering directions by defining the barrier function as the log-density ratio between positive and negative activations, and employs it to construct an ODE for \textit{multi-step and adaptive} steering. Compared to state-of-the-art activation steering methods, ODESteer achieves consistent empirical improvements on diverse LLM alignment benchmarks, a notable $5.7\%$ improvement over TruthfulQA, $2.5\%$ over UltraFeedback, and $2.4\%$ over RealToxicityPrompts. Our work establishes a principled new view of activation steering in LLM alignment by unifying its theoretical foundations via ODEs, and validating it empirically through the proposed ODESteer method.

AI.title_translation: ODESteer：基于常微分方程的统一引导框架用于大语言模型对齐
AI.tldr: 本文提出ODESteer，将激活引导统一建模为ODE求解，通过障碍函数实现多步自适应引导，在多个对齐基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法缺乏统一理论框架，且依赖一步引导难以捕捉复杂激活分布模式，需要更系统且多步的引导机制。
AI.method: 将激活添加视为ODE的一阶近似，把引导方向设计转化为控制理论中的障碍函数设计；以正负激活对数密度比为障碍函数，构建多步自适应ODE引导ODESteer。
AI.result: ODESteer在TruthfulQA、UltraFeedback、RealToxicityPrompts上分别提升5.7%、2.5%、2.4%，一致优于现有激活引导方法。
AI.conclusion: ODE视角统一了激活引导的理论基础，ODESteer验证了该框架的有效性，为LLM对齐提供新的原则化方法。
AI.translation: 激活引导（或称表示工程）通过在推理时操纵大语言模型内部激活实现轻量级对齐，但现有方法缺乏统一理论框架且多依赖一步引导，难以捕获复杂激活分布。本文提出基于常微分方程的统一理论框架，将激活添加解释为ODE的一阶近似，引导方向设计转化为控制理论中的障碍函数设计，并据此提出ODESteer，实现多步自适应引导，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.summary: 针对激活引导缺乏理论且一步引导受限的问题，作者提出基于ODE的统一框架，将激活添加视为ODE近似，把引导方向转化为障碍函数设计，实现多步自适应引导。新算法ODESteer在TruthfulQA、UltraFeedback、RealToxicityPrompts基准上分别提升5.7%、2.5%、2.4%，验证其有效性。
AI.keywords: 激活引导;表示工程;大语言模型对齐;常微分方程;障碍函数;多步引导

title: A Hybrid Federated Learning Based Ensemble Approach for Lung Disease Diagnosis Leveraging Fusion of SWIN Transformer and CNN
summary: The significant advancements in computational power cre- ate a vast opportunity for using Artificial Intelligence in different ap- plications of healthcare and medical science. A Hybrid FL-Enabled Ensemble Approach For Lung Disease Diagnosis Leveraging a Combination of SWIN Transformer and CNN is the combination of cutting-edge technology of AI and Federated Learning. Since, medi- cal specialists and hospitals will have shared data space, based on that data, with the help of Artificial Intelligence and integration of federated learning, we can introduce a secure and distributed system for medical data processing and create an efficient and reliable system. The proposed hybrid model enables the detection of COVID-19 and Pneumonia based on x-ray reports. We will use advanced and the latest available tech- nology offered by Tensorflow and Keras along with Microsoft-developed Vision Transformer, that can help to fight against the pandemic that the world has to fight together as a united. We focused on using the latest available CNN models (DenseNet201, Inception V3, VGG 19) and the Transformer model SWIN Transformer in order to prepare our hy- brid model that can provide a reliable solution as a helping hand for the physician in the medical field. In this research, we will discuss how the Federated learning-based Hybrid AI model can improve the accuracy of disease diagnosis and severity prediction of a patient using the real-time continual learning approach and how the integration of federated learn- ing can ensure hybrid model security and keep the authenticity of the information.

title: Be Wary of Your Time Series Preprocessing
comments: Accepted at the AI4TS workshop at AAAI-26
summary: Normalization and scaling are fundamental preprocessing steps in time series modeling, yet their role in Transformer-based models remains underexplored from a theoretical perspective. In this work, we present the first formal analysis of how different normalization strategies, specifically instance-based and global scaling, impact the expressivity of Transformer-based architectures for time series representation learning. We propose a novel expressivity framework tailored to time series, which quantifies a model's ability to distinguish between similar and dissimilar inputs in the representation space. Using this framework, we derive theoretical bounds for two widely used normalization methods: Standard and Min-Max scaling. Our analysis reveals that the choice of normalization strategy can significantly influence the model's representational capacity, depending on the task and data characteristics. We complement our theory with empirical validation on classification and forecasting benchmarks using multiple Transformer-based models. Our results show that no single normalization method consistently outperforms others, and in some cases, omitting normalization entirely leads to superior performance. These findings highlight the critical role of preprocessing in time series learning and motivate the need for more principled normalization strategies tailored to specific tasks and datasets.

AI.title_translation: 警惕你的时间序列预处理
AI.tldr: 首次从理论上分析不同归一化策略（Instance与全局）对Transformer时间序列表征能力的影响，发现不存在普适最优方法，甚至有时不做归一化反而更好。
AI.motivation: 尽管归一化与缩放是时间序列建模的基础步骤，其在Transformer中的理论作用长期被忽视，亟需揭示不同策略如何影响模型表征能力。
AI.method: 提出面向时间序列的表征能力框架，量化模型区分相似/不相似输入的能力；在该框架下对Standard与Min-Max两种归一化推导理论上下界，并在分类与预测任务上做多Transformer实证验证。
AI.result: 理论表明归一化策略会显著改变模型的表征容量，且影响程度依赖任务与数据特性；实验显示没有一种归一化始终最优，部分场景下省略归一化反而性能更佳。
AI.conclusion: 预处理对时间序列学习至关重要，应根据具体任务与数据设计更有针对性的归一化策略，而非默认使用传统方法。
AI.translation: 归一化与缩放是时间序列建模中的基本预处理步骤，但它们在基于Transformer的模型中的理论作用尚未被深入探讨。本文首次形式化分析了不同归一化策略（实例级与全局缩放）如何影响Transformer架构在时间序列表征学习中的表达能力。我们提出了一个专门针对时间序列的表达能力框架，用于量化模型在表征空间中区分相似与不相似输入的能力。在该框架下，我们为两种常用的归一化方法（Standard与Min-Max缩放）推导出理论界限。分析表明，归一化策略的选择会显著影响模型的表征容量，且影响程度取决于任务与数据特性。我们通过在分类与预测基准上使用多种Transformer模型进行实证验证，结果显示没有一种归一化方法始终优于其他方法，某些情况下完全省略归一化反而获得更好性能。这些发现突显了预处理在时间序列学习中的关键作用，并激励人们为特定任务与数据集设计更有原则的归一化策略。
AI.summary: 本文从理论角度首次系统研究了时间序列预处理中归一化策略对Transformer表征能力的影响，提出新表达能力框架并给出Standard与Min-Max缩放的界限，理论与实验共同表明归一化选择需任务导向，盲目使用传统方法可能降低性能。
AI.keywords: 时间序列预处理，归一化，Transformer，表征能力，Standard缩放，Min-Max缩放
AI.comments: 研究填补了归一化在Transformer时间序列建模中的理论空白，建议未来开发任务自适应的归一化策略，并探索与分布偏移及频域特性的结合。

title: FR-GESTURE: An RGBD Dataset For Gesture-based Human-Robot Interaction In First Responder Operations
summary: The ever increasing intensity and number of disasters make even more difficult the work of First Responders (FRs). Artificial intelligence and robotics solutions could facilitate their operations, compensating these difficulties. To this end, we propose a dataset for gesture-based UGV control by FRs, introducing a set of 12 commands, drawing inspiration from existing gestures used by FRs and tactical hand signals and refined after incorporating feedback from experienced FRs. Then we proceed with the data collection itself, resulting in 3312 RGBD pairs captured from 2 viewpoints and 7 distances. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dataset especially intended for gesture-based UGV guidance by FRs. Finally we define evaluation protocols for our RGBD dataset, termed FR-GESTURE, and we perform baseline experiments, which are put forward for improvement. We have made data publicly available to promote future research on the domain: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18131333.

title: Hybrid System Planning using a Mixed-Integer ADMM Heuristic and Hybrid Zonotopes
summary: Embedded optimization-based planning for hybrid systems is challenging due to the use of mixed-integer programming, which is computationally intensive and often sensitive to the specific numerical formulation. To address that challenge, this article proposes a framework for motion planning of hybrid systems that pairs hybrid zonotopes - an advanced set representation - with a new alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) mixed-integer programming heuristic. A general treatment of piecewise affine (PWA) system reachability analysis using hybrid zonotopes is presented and extended to formulate optimal planning problems. Sets produced using the proposed identities have lower memory complexity and tighter convex relaxations than equivalent sets produced from preexisting techniques. The proposed ADMM heuristic makes efficient use of the hybrid zonotope structure. For planning problems formulated as hybrid zonotopes, the proposed heuristic achieves improved convergence rates as compared to state-of-the-art mixed-integer programming heuristics. The proposed methods for hybrid system planning on embedded hardware are experimentally applied in a combined behavior and motion planning scenario for autonomous driving.

title: Simultaneous Blackwell Approachability and Applications to Multiclass Omniprediction
summary: Omniprediction is a learning problem that requires suboptimality bounds for each of a family of losses $\mathcal{L}$ against a family of comparator predictors $\mathcal{C}$. We initiate the study of omniprediction in a multiclass setting, where the comparator family $\mathcal{C}$ may be infinite. Our main result is an extension of the recent binary omniprediction algorithm of [OKK25] to the multiclass setting, with sample complexity (in statistical settings) or regret horizon (in online settings) $\approx \varepsilon^{-(k+1)}$, for $\varepsilon$-omniprediction in a $k$-class prediction problem. En route to proving this result, we design a framework of potential broader interest for solving Blackwell approachability problems where multiple sets must simultaneously be approached via coupled actions.

title: Canonicalizing Multimodal Contrastive Representation Learning
summary:
As models and data scale, independently trained networks often induce analogous notions of similarity. But, matching similarities is weaker than establishing an explicit correspondence between the representation spaces, especially for multimodal models, where consistency must hold not only within each modality, but also for the learned image-text coupling. We therefore ask: given two independently trained multimodal contrastive models (with encoders $(f, g)$ and $(\widetilde{f},\widetilde{g})$) -- trained on different distributions and with different architectures -- does a systematic geometric relationship exist between their embedding spaces? If so, what form does it take, and does it hold uniformly across modalities? In this work, we show that across model families such as CLIP, SigLIP, and FLAVA, this geometric relationship is well approximated by an orthogonal map (up to a global mean shift), i.e., there exists an orthogonal map $Q$ where $Q^\top Q = I$ such that $\widetilde{f}(x)\approx Q f(x)$ for paired images $x$. Strikingly, the same $Q$ simultaneously aligns the text encoders i.e., $\widetilde{g}(y)\approx Q g(y)$ for texts $y$. Theoretically, we prove that if the multimodal kernel agrees across models on a small anchor set i.e. $\langle f(x), g(y)\rangle \approx \langle \widetilde{f}(x), \widetilde{g}(y)\rangle$, then the two models must be related by a single orthogonal map $Q$ and the same $Q$ maps images and text across models. More broadly, this finding enables backward-compatible model upgrades, avoiding costly re-embedding, and has implications for the privacy of learned representations.
  Our project page: https://canonical-multimodal.github.io/

title: Conditional Flow Matching for Continuous Anomaly Detection in Autonomous Driving on a Manifold-Aware Spectral Space
summary: Safety validation for Level 4 autonomous vehicles (AVs) is currently bottlenecked by the inability to scale the detection of rare, high-risk long-tail scenarios using traditional rule-based heuristics. We present Deep-Flow, an unsupervised framework for safety-critical anomaly detection that utilizes Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching (OT-CFM) to characterize the continuous probability density of expert human driving behavior. Unlike standard generative approaches that operate in unstable, high-dimensional coordinate spaces, Deep-Flow constrains the generative process to a low-rank spectral manifold via a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) bottleneck. This ensures kinematic smoothness by design and enables the computation of the exact Jacobian trace for numerically stable, deterministic log-likelihood estimation. To resolve multi-modal ambiguity at complex junctions, we utilize an Early Fusion Transformer encoder with lane-aware goal conditioning, featuring a direct skip-connection to the flow head to maintain intent-integrity throughout the network. We introduce a kinematic complexity weighting scheme that prioritizes high-energy maneuvers (quantified via path tortuosity and jerk) during the simulation-free training process. Evaluated on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset (WOMD), our framework achieves an AUC-ROC of 0.766 against a heuristic golden set of safety-critical events. More significantly, our analysis reveals a fundamental distinction between kinematic danger and semantic non-compliance. Deep-Flow identifies a critical predictability gap by surfacing out-of-distribution behaviors, such as lane-boundary violations and non-normative junction maneuvers, that traditional safety filters overlook. This work provides a mathematically rigorous foundation for defining statistical safety gates, enabling objective, data-driven validation for the safe deployment of autonomous fleets.
